0004926:                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_RAX, 64),
0004927:                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_memory(X64_REGISTER_RBP, 64, slots[0]),
0004928:             };
0004929:             BusterX86MetadataPhysicalAttributes attributes = masked
0004930:                                                                   ? (BusterX86MetadataPhysicalAttributes){
0004931:                                                                         .decorator_flags = BUSTER_X86_METADATA_DECORATOR_MASK | BUSTER_X86_METADATA_DECORATOR_ZEROING,
0004932:                                                                         .mask_register = X64_SIMD_MASK,
0004933:                                                                         .has_mask_register = true,
0004934:                                                                         .zeroing = true,
0004935:                                                                     }
0004936:                                                                   : (BusterX86MetadataPhysicalAttributes){0};
0004937:             if (!codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_emit(buffer, S8("MOV"), pointer_load, BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(pointer_load)) ||
0004938:                 !codegen_canonical_x64_simd_emit_zmm_memory(buffer, S8("VMOVDQU8"), X64_SIMD_VECTOR_FIRST, X64_REGISTER_RAX, 0, false, 8,
0004939:                                                             attributes) ||
0004940:                 !codegen_canonical_x64_simd_emit_zmm_memory(buffer, S8("VMOVDQU8"), X64_SIMD_VECTOR_FIRST, X64_REGISTER_RBP, result_slot, true, 8,
0004941:                                                             (BusterX86MetadataPhysicalAttributes){0}))
0004942:             {
0004943:                 return false;
0004944:             }
0004945:             return buffer->error == CODEGEN_ERROR_NONE;
0004946:         }
0004947:         case IR_SIMD_STORE:
0004948:         case IR_SIMD_STORE_MASKED:
0004949:         case IR_SIMD_COMPRESS_STORE_BYTE:
0004950:         {
0004951:             bool masked = operation != IR_SIMD_STORE;
0004952:             u32 vector_operand = masked ? 2 : 1;
0004953:             if (masked)
0004954:             {
0004955:                 if (!codegen_canonical_x64_simd_emit_kmov_frame(buffer, X64_SIMD_MASK, false, slots[1]))
0004956:                 {
0004957:                     return false;
0004958:                 }
0004959:             }
0004960:             BusterX86MetadataPhysicalOperand pointer_load[2] = {
0004961:                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_RAX, 64),
0004962:                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_memory(X64_REGISTER_RBP, 64, slots[0]),
0004963:             };
0004964:             BusterX86MetadataPhysicalAttributes attributes = masked
0004965:                                                                   ? (BusterX86MetadataPhysicalAttributes){
0004966:                                                                         .decorator_flags = BUSTER_X86_METADATA_DECORATOR_MASK,
0004967:                                                                         .mask_register = X64_SIMD_MASK,
0004968:                                                                         .has_mask_register = true,
0004969:                                                                     }
0004970:                                                                   : (BusterX86MetadataPhysicalAttributes){0};
0004971:             // vpcompressb writes its destination through the rm operand, so the
0004972:             // compressing store and the plain store share this shape exactly.
0004973:             String8 store_mnemonic = operation == IR_SIMD_COMPRESS_STORE_BYTE ? S8("VPCOMPRESSB") : S8("VMOVDQU8");
0004974:             u16 store_memory_width = 8;
0004975:             if (!codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_emit(buffer, S8("MOV"), pointer_load, BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(pointer_load)) ||
0004976:                 !codegen_canonical_x64_simd_emit_zmm_memory(buffer, S8("VMOVDQU8"), X64_SIMD_VECTOR_FIRST, X64_REGISTER_RBP,
0004977:                                                             slots[vector_operand], false, 8, (BusterX86MetadataPhysicalAttributes){0}) ||
0004978:                 !codegen_canonical_x64_simd_emit_zmm_memory(buffer, store_mnemonic, X64_SIMD_VECTOR_FIRST, X64_REGISTER_RAX, 0, true, store_memory_width,
0004979:                                                             attributes))
0004980:             {
0004981:                 return false;
0004982:             }
0004983:             return buffer->error == CODEGEN_ERROR_NONE;
0004984:         }
0004985:         case IR_SIMD_SPLAT_WORD:
0004986:         {
0004987:             // The dword source is already 32 bits wide, so it loads with a
0004988:             // plain MOV where the byte splat needs a zero extension.
0004989:             BusterX86MetadataPhysicalOperand load_operands[2] = {
0004990:                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_RAX, 32),
0004991:                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_memory(X64_REGISTER_RBP, 32, slots[0]),
0004992:             };
0004993:             if (!codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_emit(buffer, S8("MOV"), load_operands, BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(load_operands)) ||
0004994:                 !codegen_canonical_x64_simd_emit_zmm_gpr(buffer, S8("VPBROADCASTD"), X64_SIMD_VECTOR_FIRST, X64_REGISTER_RAX,
0004995:                                                          (BusterX86MetadataPhysicalAttributes){0}) ||
0004996:                 !codegen_canonical_x64_simd_emit_zmm_memory(buffer, S8("VMOVDQU8"), X64_SIMD_VECTOR_FIRST, X64_REGISTER_RBP, result_slot, true, 8,
0004997:                                                             (BusterX86MetadataPhysicalAttributes){0}))
0004998:             {
0004999:                 return false;
0005000:             }
0005001:             return buffer->error == CODEGEN_ERROR_NONE;
0005002:         }
0005003:         case IR_SIMD_SPLAT_BYTE:
0005004:         {
0005005:             BusterX86MetadataPhysicalOperand load_operands[2] = {
0005006:                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_RAX, 32),
0005007:                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_memory(X64_REGISTER_RBP, 8, slots[0]),
0005008:             };
0005009:             if (!codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_emit(buffer, S8("MOVZX"), load_operands, BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(load_operands)) ||
0005010:                 !codegen_canonical_x64_simd_emit_zmm_gpr(buffer, S8("VPBROADCASTB"), X64_SIMD_VECTOR_FIRST, X64_REGISTER_RAX,
0005011:                                                          (BusterX86MetadataPhysicalAttributes){0}) ||
0005012:                 !codegen_canonical_x64_simd_emit_zmm_memory(buffer, S8("VMOVDQU8"), X64_SIMD_VECTOR_FIRST, X64_REGISTER_RBP, result_slot, true, 8,
0005013:                                                             (BusterX86MetadataPhysicalAttributes){0}))
0005014:             {
0005015:                 return false;
0005016:             }
0005017:             return buffer->error == CODEGEN_ERROR_NONE;
0005018:         }
0005019:         case IR_SIMD_COMPARE_EQUAL_BYTE:
0005020:         case IR_SIMD_COMPARE_LESS_BYTE:
0005021:         case IR_SIMD_TEST_MASK_BYTE:
0005022:         case IR_SIMD_COMPARE_EQUAL_WORD:
0005023:         case IR_SIMD_COMPARE_LESS_WORD:
0005024:         {
0005025:             String8 mnemonic = operation == IR_SIMD_COMPARE_EQUAL_BYTE ? S8("VPCMPEQB")
0005026:                                 : operation == IR_SIMD_COMPARE_LESS_BYTE ? S8("VPCMPUB")
0005027:                                 : operation == IR_SIMD_COMPARE_EQUAL_WORD ? S8("VPCMPEQD")
0005028:                                 : operation == IR_SIMD_COMPARE_LESS_WORD  ? S8("VPCMPUD")
0005029:                                                                           : S8("VPTESTMB");
0005030:             // The dword compares write 16 mask bits and zero the rest of the k
0005031:             // register, so the shared 64-bit KMOVQ spill stays exact for them.
0005032:             u16 element_width = operation == IR_SIMD_COMPARE_EQUAL_WORD || operation == IR_SIMD_COMPARE_LESS_WORD ? 32 : 8;
0005033:             bool predicate_immediate = operation == IR_SIMD_COMPARE_LESS_BYTE || operation == IR_SIMD_COMPARE_LESS_WORD;
0005034:             if (!codegen_canonical_x64_simd_emit_zmm_memory(buffer, S8("VMOVDQU8"), X64_SIMD_VECTOR_FIRST, X64_REGISTER_RBP, slots[0], false, 8,
0005035:                                                             (BusterX86MetadataPhysicalAttributes){0}) ||
0005036:                 !codegen_canonical_x64_simd_emit_mask_zmm_memory(buffer, mnemonic, X64_SIMD_MASK, X64_SIMD_VECTOR_FIRST,
0005037:                                                                  X64_REGISTER_RBP, slots[1], element_width, predicate_immediate ? 1 : 0,
0005038:                                                                  predicate_immediate) ||
0005039:                 !codegen_canonical_x64_simd_emit_kmov_frame(buffer, X64_SIMD_MASK, true, result_slot))
0005040:             {
0005041:                 return false;
0005042:             }
0005043:             return buffer->error == CODEGEN_ERROR_NONE;
0005044:         }
0005045:         case IR_SIMD_SIGN_MASK_BYTE:
0005046:         {
0005047:             if (!codegen_canonical_x64_simd_emit_zmm_memory(buffer, S8("VMOVDQU8"), X64_SIMD_VECTOR_FIRST, X64_REGISTER_RBP, slots[0], false, 8,
0005048:                                                             (BusterX86MetadataPhysicalAttributes){0}) ||
0005049:                 !codegen_canonical_x64_simd_emit_mask_zmm_register(buffer, S8("VPMOVB2M"), X64_SIMD_MASK, X64_SIMD_VECTOR_FIRST) ||
0005050:                 !codegen_canonical_x64_simd_emit_kmov_frame(buffer, X64_SIMD_MASK, true, result_slot))
0005051:             {
0005052:                 return false;
0005053:             }
0005054:             return buffer->error == CODEGEN_ERROR_NONE;
0005055:         }
0005056:         case IR_SIMD_PERMUTE2_BYTE:
0005057:         {
0005058:             if (!codegen_canonical_x64_simd_emit_kmov_frame(buffer, X64_SIMD_MASK, false, slots[0]))
0005059:             {
0005060:                 return false;
0005061:             }
0005062:             X64Evex load = move_load;
0005063:             load.reg = X64_SIMD_VECTOR_FIRST;
0005064:             if (!codegen_canonical_x64_evex_frame(buffer, load, slots[1]))
0005065:             {
0005066:                 return false;
0005067:             }
0005068:             load.reg = X64_SIMD_VECTOR_SECOND;
0005069:             if (!codegen_canonical_x64_evex_frame(buffer, load, slots[2]))
0005070:             {
0005071:                 return false;
0005072:             }
0005073:             // vpermt2b reads the low table from its destination and the high table
0005074:             // from rm, so the destination is loaded with the low table first and
0005075:             // the masked write lands on top of it.
0005076:             X64Evex permute = {
0005077:                 .map = 2,
0005078:                 .prefix = 1,
0005079:                 .opcode = 0x7d,
0005080:                 .reg = X64_SIMD_VECTOR_FIRST,
0005081:                 .vvvv = X64_SIMD_VECTOR_SECOND,
0005082:                 .mask = X64_SIMD_MASK,
0005083:                 .zeroing = true,
0005084:             };
0005085:             if (!codegen_canonical_x64_evex_frame(buffer, permute, slots[3]))
0005086:             {
0005087:                 return false;
0005088:             }
0005089:             X64Evex spill = move_store;
0005090:             spill.reg = X64_SIMD_VECTOR_FIRST;
0005091:             return codegen_canonical_x64_evex_frame(buffer, spill, result_slot);
0005092:         }
0005093:         case IR_SIMD_COMPRESS_BYTE:
0005094:         case IR_SIMD_COMPRESS_WORD:
0005095:         {
0005096:             if (!codegen_canonical_x64_simd_emit_kmov_frame(buffer, X64_SIMD_MASK, false, slots[0]))
0005097:             {
0005098:                 return false;
0005099:             }
0005100:             X64Evex load = move_load;
0005101:             load.reg = X64_SIMD_VECTOR_SECOND;
0005102:             if (!codegen_canonical_x64_evex_frame(buffer, load, slots[1]))
0005103:             {
0005104:                 return false;
0005105:             }
0005106:             // Register form: rm is the destination and reg is the source, so the
0005107:             // source is the one that gets loaded and the result lands in the
0005108:             // first register like every other operation's does. The dword form
0005109:             // reads its 16 mask bits from the same 64-bit spill the byte form
0005110:             // fills, so the two share every step but the opcode.
0005111:             X64Evex compress = {
0005112:                 .map = 2,
0005113:                 .prefix = 1,
0005114:                 .opcode = operation == IR_SIMD_COMPRESS_BYTE ? 0x63 : 0x8b,
0005115:                 .reg = X64_SIMD_VECTOR_SECOND,
0005116:                 .mask = X64_SIMD_MASK,
0005117:                 .zeroing = true,
0005118:             };
0005119:             if (!codegen_canonical_x64_evex_register(buffer, compress, X64_SIMD_VECTOR_FIRST))
0005120:             {
0005121:                 return false;
0005122:             }
0005123:             X64Evex spill = move_store;
0005124:             spill.reg = X64_SIMD_VECTOR_FIRST;
0005125:             return codegen_canonical_x64_evex_frame(buffer, spill, result_slot);
0005126:         }
0005127:         case IR_SIMD_WIDEN_BYTE_TO_WORD:
0005128:         {
0005129:             // The source already lives in memory, so the quarter selection is an
0005130:             // address offset and vpmovzxbd reads its 16 bytes straight from there
0005131:             // — no vextracti32x4 in front of it.
0005132:             X64Evex widen = {.map = 2, .prefix = 1, .opcode = 0x31, .reg = X64_SIMD_VECTOR_FIRST};
0005133:             if (!codegen_canonical_x64_evex_frame(buffer, widen, slots[0] + (s32)immediate * 16))
0005134:             {
0005135:                 return false;
0005136:             }
0005137:             X64Evex spill = move_store;
0005138:             spill.reg = X64_SIMD_VECTOR_FIRST;
0005139:             return codegen_canonical_x64_evex_frame(buffer, spill, result_slot);
0005140:         }
0005141:         case IR_SIMD_SHIFT_LEFT_WORD:
0005142:         {
0005143:             if (!codegen_canonical_x64_evex_frame(buffer, move_load, slots[0]) ||
0005144:                 !codegen_canonical_x64_simd_emit_zmm_register_immediate(buffer, S8("VPSLLD"), X64_SIMD_VECTOR_FIRST,
0005145:                                                                           X64_SIMD_VECTOR_FIRST, immediate))
0005146:             {
0005147:                 return false;
0005148:             }
0005149:             X64Evex spill = move_store;
0005150:             spill.reg = X64_SIMD_VECTOR_FIRST;
0005151:             return codegen_canonical_x64_evex_frame(buffer, spill, result_slot);
0005152:         }
0005153:         case IR_SIMD_TERNARY_WORD:
0005154:         {
0005155:             X64Evex load = move_load;
0005156:             load.reg = X64_SIMD_VECTOR_FIRST;
0005157:             if (!codegen_canonical_x64_evex_frame(buffer, load, slots[0]))
0005158:             {
0005159:                 return false;
0005160:             }
0005161:             load.reg = X64_SIMD_VECTOR_SECOND;
0005162:             if (!codegen_canonical_x64_evex_frame(buffer, load, slots[1]))
0005163:             {
0005164:                 return false;
0005165:             }
0005166:             load.reg = X64_SIMD_VECTOR_THIRD;
0005167:             if (!codegen_canonical_x64_evex_frame(buffer, load, slots[2]) ||
0005168:                 !codegen_canonical_x64_simd_emit_zmm_ternary_immediate(buffer, S8("VPTERNLOGD"), X64_SIMD_VECTOR_FIRST,
0005169:                                                                          X64_SIMD_VECTOR_SECOND, X64_SIMD_VECTOR_THIRD, immediate))
0005170:             {
0005171:                 return false;
0005172:             }
0005173:             X64Evex spill = move_store;
0005174:             spill.reg = X64_SIMD_VECTOR_FIRST;
0005175:             return codegen_canonical_x64_evex_frame(buffer, spill, result_slot);
0005176:         }
0005177:         case IR_SIMD_COUNT:
0005178:             break;
0005179:         }
0005180:     }
0005181: 
0005182:     return false;
0005183: }

0005185: 
0005186: BUSTER_GLOBAL_LOCAL bool codegen_canonical_x64_instruction_uses_wide_vector(IrProgram* program, IrFunction* function, IrInstruction* instruction, Target target)
0005187: {
0005188:     if (instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_SIMD)
0005189:     {
0005190:         // A run of these is the whole point of the vocabulary; splitting it
0005191:         // with a vzeroupper between every pair would cost more than the
0005192:         // transition it avoids.
0005193:         return ir_simd_operation_supported(target, (IrSimdOperation)instruction->simd_operation);
0005194:     }
0005195:     if (instruction->opcode != IR_OPCODE_BINARY || instruction->operand_count != 2 || instruction->binary_operation >= IR_BINARY_VECTOR_INTEGER_EQUAL)
0005196:     {
0005197:         return false;
0005198:     }
0005199:     IrType* vector = ir_type_from_id(&program->types, function->values[instruction->operands[0].value].canonical_type);
0005200:     IrType* element = vector && vector->kind == IR_TYPE_VECTOR ? ir_type_from_id(&program->types, vector->element_type) : 0;
0005201:     if (!element || (element->kind != IR_TYPE_INTEGER && element->kind != IR_TYPE_FLOAT) ||
0005202:         !x64_target_supports_native_vector(target, vector->layout.size, element->bit_width, element->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER))
0005203:     {
0005204:         return false;
0005205:     }
0005206:     switch (instruction->binary_operation)
0005207:     {
0005208:     case IR_BINARY_VECTOR_FLOAT_ADD:
0005209:     case IR_BINARY_VECTOR_FLOAT_SUBTRACT:
0005210:     case IR_BINARY_VECTOR_FLOAT_MULTIPLY:
0005211:     case IR_BINARY_VECTOR_FLOAT_DIVIDE:
0005212:     case IR_BINARY_VECTOR_INTEGER_ADD:
0005213:     case IR_BINARY_VECTOR_INTEGER_SUBTRACT:
0005214:     case IR_BINARY_VECTOR_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND:
0005215:     case IR_BINARY_VECTOR_INTEGER_BITWISE_OR:
0005216:     case IR_BINARY_VECTOR_INTEGER_BITWISE_XOR:
0005217:         return true;
0005218:     default:
0005219:         return false;
0005220:     }
0005221: }
0005222: 
0005223: BUSTER_GLOBAL_LOCAL bool codegen_canonical_x64_instruction_preserves_wide_vector(IrProgram* program, IrInstruction* instruction)
0005224: {
0005225:     if (instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_FIELD)
0005226:     {
0005227:         return true;
0005228:     }
0005229:     if (instruction->opcode != IR_OPCODE_LOAD || instruction->result.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
0005230:     {
0005231:         return false;
0005232:     }
0005233:     IrType* result_type = ir_type_from_id(&program->types, instruction->canonical_type);
0005234:     return result_type && result_type->kind == IR_TYPE_VECTOR && result_type->layout.resolved && result_type->layout.size && result_type->layout.size <= 64;
0005235: }
0005236: 
0005237: BUSTER_GLOBAL_LOCAL bool codegen_canonical_x64_vector_operation(CodegenBuffer* output, IrProgram* program, IrFunction* function, IrInstruction* instruction,
0005238:                                                                 u32 const* value_offsets, u32 frame_base_offset, Target target, u64* native_operation_count,
0005239:                                                                 u64* split_operation_count, bool* upper_vector_dirty, IrValueId* last_wide_vector_result,
0005240:                                                                 u32* last_wide_vector_size, u64* forwarded_wide_vector_load_count)
0005241: {
0005242:     if (!instruction->operand_count)
0005243:     {
0005244:         return false;
0005245:     }
0005246:     IrTypeId operand_type_id = function->values[instruction->operands[0].value].canonical_type;
0005247:     IrType* vector = ir_type_from_id(&program->types, operand_type_id);
0005248:     IrType* element = vector ? ir_type_from_id(&program->types, vector->element_type) : 0;
0005249:     if (!vector || vector->kind != IR_TYPE_VECTOR || !codegen_vector_element_supported(element) ||
0005250:         instruction->result.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
0005251:     {
0005252:         return false;
0005253:     }
0005254:     u32 lane_size = element->bit_width / 8;
0005255:     if ((u64)lane_size * vector->element_count != vector->layout.size || vector->element_count > UINT32_MAX)
0005256:     {
0005257:         return false;
0005258:     }
0005259:     // Frame slots are addressed through the same rebase every other canonical
0005260:     // emission uses: a Win64 function with a dynamic stack sets rbp to the
0005261:     // bottom of the frame and reaches its values at positive displacements,
0005262:     // where every other target keeps rbp at the top and uses negative ones.
0005263:     // Spelling the displacement as a bare negation is only right where the
0005264:     // rebase is the identity, so it silently addressed outside the frame for
0005265:     // exactly the Windows functions this path is reached from.
0005266:     s32 left_displacement =
0005267:         codegen_canonical_x64_rebase_frame_displacement(output, -(s64)value_offsets[instruction->operands[0].value], frame_base_offset);
0005268:     s32 result_displacement =
0005269:         codegen_canonical_x64_rebase_frame_displacement(output, -(s64)value_offsets[instruction->result.value], frame_base_offset);
0005270:     s32 right_displacement =
0005271:         instruction->operand_count == 2
0005272:             ? codegen_canonical_x64_rebase_frame_displacement(output, -(s64)value_offsets[instruction->operands[1].value], frame_base_offset)
0005273:             : 0;
0005274:     X64Builder builder = {
0005275:         .buffer = *output,
0005276:     };
0005277:     codegen_canonical_x64_address(&builder.buffer, X64_REGISTER_R8, left_displacement);
0005278:     if (instruction->operand_count == 2)
0005279:     {
0005280:         codegen_canonical_x64_address(&builder.buffer, X64_REGISTER_R9, right_displacement);
0005281:     }
0005282:     codegen_canonical_x64_address(&builder.buffer, X64_REGISTER_R10, result_displacement);
0005283:     if (builder.buffer.error != CODEGEN_ERROR_NONE)
0005284:     {
0005285:         return false;
0005286:     }
0005287:     bool comparison = instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_BINARY && instruction->binary_operation >= IR_BINARY_VECTOR_INTEGER_EQUAL &&
0005288:                       instruction->binary_operation <= IR_BINARY_VECTOR_FLOAT_GREATER_EQUAL;
0005289:     u8 condition = 0;
0005290:     bool ordered = false;
0005291:     bool unordered = false;
0005292:     if (comparison && !x64_vector_comparison_condition(instruction->binary_operation, &condition, &ordered, &unordered))
0005293:     {
0005294:         return false;
0005295:     }
0005296:     bool wide_native = x64_target_supports_native_vector(target, vector->layout.size, element->bit_width, element->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER) &&
0005297:                        instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_BINARY && instruction->operand_count == 2 && !comparison;
0005298:     if (wide_native)
0005299:     {
0005300:         u8 operation = 0;
0005301:         u8 prefix = 0;
0005302:         if (element->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT)
0005303:         {
0005304:             prefix = element->bit_width == 64 ? 0x66 : 0;
0005305:             operation = instruction->binary_operation == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_FLOAT_ADD        ? 0x58
0005306:                         : instruction->binary_operation == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_FLOAT_SUBTRACT ? 0x5c
0005307:                         : instruction->binary_operation == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_FLOAT_MULTIPLY ? 0x59
0005308:                         : instruction->binary_operation == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_FLOAT_DIVIDE   ? 0x5e
0005309:                                                                                            : 0;
0005310:         }
0005311:         else
0005312:         {
0005313:             prefix = 0x66;
0005314:             IrBinaryOperation binary = instruction->binary_operation;
0005315:             if (binary == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_INTEGER_ADD)
0005316:             {
0005317:                 operation = element->bit_width == 8 ? 0xfc : element->bit_width == 16 ? 0xfd : element->bit_width == 32 ? 0xfe : 0xd4;
0005318:             }
0005319:             else if (binary == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_INTEGER_SUBTRACT)
0005320:             {
0005321:                 operation = element->bit_width == 8 ? 0xf8 : element->bit_width == 16 ? 0xf9 : element->bit_width == 32 ? 0xfa : 0xfb;
0005322:             }
0005323:             else if (binary == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND || binary == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_INTEGER_BITWISE_OR ||
0005324:                      binary == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_INTEGER_BITWISE_XOR)
0005325:             {
0005326:                 operation = binary == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND ? 0xdb : binary == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_INTEGER_BITWISE_OR ? 0xeb : 0xef;
0005327:             }
0005328:         }
0005329:         if (operation)
0005330:         {
0005331:             bool forwarded_left =

0005756:                 }
0005757:                 x64_emit_store_memory(&builder, X64_REGISTER_R10, offset, X64_REGISTER_RAX, lane_size);
0005758:                 if (builder.buffer.error != CODEGEN_ERROR_NONE)
0005759:                 {
0005760:                     return false;
0005761:                 }
0005762:                 continue;
0005763:             }
0005764:             BusterX86MetadataPhysicalOperand compare_operands[2] = {
0005765:                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_RAX, (u16)(lane_size * 8)),
0005766:                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_RCX, (u16)(lane_size * 8)),
0005767:             };
0005768:             if (!codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_emit(&builder.buffer, S8("CMP"), compare_operands,
0005769:                                                       BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(compare_operands)))
0005770:             {
0005771:                 return false;
0005772:             }
0005773:         }
0005774:         String8 condition_mnemonic = condition == 0x94 ? S8("SETZ")
0005775:                                       : condition == 0x95 ? S8("SETNZ")
0005776:                                       : condition == 0x9c ? S8("SETL")
0005777:                                       : condition == 0x9e ? S8("SETLE")
0005778:                                       : condition == 0x9f ? S8("SETNLE")
0005779:                                       : condition == 0x9d ? S8("SETNL")
0005780:                                       : condition == 0x92 ? S8("SETB")
0005781:                                       : condition == 0x96 ? S8("SETBE")
0005782:                                       : condition == 0x97 ? S8("SETNBE")
0005783:                                       : condition == 0x93 ? S8("SETNB")
0005784:                                                          : (String8){0};
0005785:         if (!condition_mnemonic.length)
0005786:         {
0005787:             return false;
0005788:         }
0005789:         BusterX86MetadataPhysicalOperand set_operands[] = {
0005790:             codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_RAX, 8),
0005791:         };
0005792:         if (!codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_emit(&builder.buffer, condition_mnemonic, set_operands,
0005793:                                                   BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(set_operands)))
0005794:         {
0005795:             return false;
0005796:         }
0005797:         if (ordered || unordered)
0005798:         {
0005799:             BusterX86MetadataPhysicalOperand unordered_operands[] = {
0005800:                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_RDX, 8),
0005801:             };
0005802:             if (!codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_emit(&builder.buffer, unordered ? S8("SETP") : S8("SETNP"), unordered_operands,
0005803:                                                       BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(unordered_operands)))
0005804:             {
0005805:                 return false;
0005806:             }
0005807:             BusterX86MetadataPhysicalOperand ordered_operands[2] = {
0005808:                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_RAX, 8),
0005809:                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_RDX, 8),
0005810:             };
0005811:             if (!codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_emit(&builder.buffer, unordered ? S8("OR") : S8("AND"), ordered_operands,
0005812:                                                       BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(ordered_operands)))
0005813:             {
0005814:                 return false;
0005815:             }
0005816:         }
0005817:         BusterX86MetadataPhysicalOperand widen_operands[2] = {
0005818:             codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_RAX, 32),
0005819:             codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_RAX, 8),
0005820:         };
0005821:         if (!codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_emit(&builder.buffer, S8("MOVZX"), widen_operands,
0005822:                                                   BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(widen_operands)))
0005823:         {
0005824:             return false;
0005825:         }
0005826:         BusterX86MetadataPhysicalOperand negate_operands[] = {
0005827:             codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_RAX, 64),
0005828:         };
0005829:         if (!codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_emit(&builder.buffer, S8("NEG"), negate_operands,
0005830:                                                   BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(negate_operands)))
0005831:         {
0005832:             return false;
0005833:         }
0005834:         x64_emit_store_memory(&builder, X64_REGISTER_R10, offset, X64_REGISTER_RAX, lane_size);
0005835:         if (builder.buffer.error != CODEGEN_ERROR_NONE)
0005836:         {
0005837:             return false;
0005838:         }
0005839:     }
0005840:     *output = builder.buffer;
0005841:     return true;
0005842: }
0005843: 
0005844: BUSTER_GLOBAL_LOCAL bool codegen_canonical_a64_memory_operation_base(CodegenBuffer* buffer, u32 register_number, u32 offset, u32 size, bool store,
0005845:                                                                      bool sign_extend, u32 base_register)
0005846: {
0005847:     u32 scale = size == 8 ? 8 : size == 4 ? 4 : size == 2 ? 2 : size == 1 ? 1 : 0;
0005848:     if (!scale || register_number > 31)
0005849:     {
0005850:         return false;
0005851:     }
0005852:     // The scaled unsigned-immediate form addresses only multiples of the
0005853:     // access width, and a bit-field's storage unit lands wherever packing put
0005854:     // it: `struct __attribute__((packed)) { char a; int v : 32; }` is read
0005855:     // through the four bytes at offset one, and the pieces of a field with no
0005856:     // single unit land at every offset in turn. The unscaled form -- LDUR and
0005857:     // STUR -- takes any byte offset in a nine-bit field, which is exactly the
0005858:     // offsets the scaled one cannot reach. Beyond that field the address is
0005859:     // materialized, and then the offset is zero and scaled again.
0005860:     bool unscaled = offset % scale != 0;
0005861:     bool indirect = unscaled ? offset > A64_UNSCALED_IMM_MAX : offset / scale > A64_IMM12_MAX;
0005862:     if (indirect)
0005863:     {
0005864:         codegen_canonical_a64_base_address(buffer, 16, base_register, offset);
0005865:         offset = 0;
0005866:         unscaled = false;
0005867:     }
0005868:     if (unscaled)
0005869:     {
0005870:         u32 unscaled_instruction = store         ? (size == 8 ? 0xf80003e0 : size == 4 ? 0xb80003e0 : size == 2 ? 0x780003e0 : 0x380003e0)
0005871:                                    : sign_extend ? (size == 4 ? 0xb88003e0 : size == 2 ? 0x788003e0 : size == 1 ? 0x388003e0 : 0xf84003e0)
0005872:                                                  : (size == 8 ? 0xf84003e0 : size == 4 ? 0xb84003e0 : size == 2 ? 0x784003e0 : 0x384003e0);
0005873:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, (unscaled_instruction & ~(31u << 5)) | (offset << 12) | (base_register << 5) | register_number);
0005874:         return true;
0005875:     }
0005876:     u32 instruction = 0;
0005877:     if (store)
0005878:     {
0005879:         instruction = size == 8 ? 0xf90003e0 : size == 4 ? 0xb90003e0 : size == 2 ? 0x790003e0 : 0x390003e0;
0005880:     }
0005881:     else if (sign_extend)
0005882:     {
0005883:         instruction = size == 4 ? 0xb98003e0 : size == 2 ? 0x798003e0 : size == 1 ? 0x398003e0 : 0xf94003e0;
0005884:     }
0005885:     else
0005886:     {
0005887:         instruction = size == 8 ? 0xf94003e0 : size == 4 ? 0xb94003e0 : size == 2 ? 0x794003e0 : 0x394003e0;
0005888:     }
0005889:     codegen_emit_u32(buffer, (instruction & ~(31u << 5)) | ((offset / scale) << 10) | ((indirect ? 16u : base_register) << 5) | register_number);
0005890:     return true;
0005891: }
0005892: 
0005893: BUSTER_GLOBAL_LOCAL bool codegen_canonical_a64_memory_operation(CodegenBuffer* buffer, u32 register_number, u32 offset, u32 size, bool store, bool sign_extend)
0005894: {
0005895:     return codegen_canonical_a64_memory_operation_base(buffer, register_number, offset, size, store, sign_extend, 31);
0005896: }
0005897: 
0005898: bool codegen_canonical_a64_frame_memory_operation(CodegenBuffer* buffer, u32 register_number, u32 offset, u32 size, bool store,
0005899:                                                                       bool sign_extend)
0005900: {
0005901:     return codegen_canonical_a64_memory_operation_base(buffer, register_number, offset, size, store, sign_extend, 28);
0005902: }
0005903: 
0005904: u32 codegen_canonical_a64_remainder_divide_instruction(bool signed_remainder, bool wide)
0005905: {
0005906:     return (signed_remainder ? 0x1aca0d2b : 0x1aca092b) | (wide ? 0x80000000 : 0);
0005907: }
0005908: 
0005909: BUSTER_GLOBAL_LOCAL u32 codegen_canonical_copy_chunk(u64 remaining, u64 source_offset, u64 destination_offset)
0005910: {
0005911:     u32 result;
0005912:     if (remaining >= 8 && source_offset % 8 == 0 && destination_offset % 8 == 0)
0005913:     {
0005914:         result = 8;
0005915:     }
0005916:     else if (remaining >= 4 && source_offset % 4 == 0 && destination_offset % 4 == 0)
0005917:     {
0005918:         result = 4;
0005919:     }
0005920:     else if (remaining >= 2 && source_offset % 2 == 0 && destination_offset % 2 == 0)
0005921:     {
0005922:         result = 2;
0005923:     }
0005924:     else
0005925:     {
0005926:         result = 1;
0005927:     }
0005928: 
0005929:     return result;
0005930: }
0005931: 
0005932: // The address of an outgoing-argument slot. The stack pointer is only sixteen
0005933: // aligned through the body, so a slot an argument needs more alignment than
0005934: // that is reserved with room to spare and rounded up here, the same lea/add/and
0005935: // an over-aligned local is given.
0005936: BUSTER_GLOBAL_LOCAL bool codegen_canonical_x64_rsp_address(CodegenBuffer* buffer, u32 register_number, u32 offset, u32 alignment)
0005937: {
0005938:     if (!buffer || register_number > 15 || offset > INT32_MAX ||
0005939:         (alignment > CODEGEN_X64_STACK_ALIGNMENT && (alignment > INT32_MAX || (alignment & (alignment - 1)))))
0005940:     {
0005941:         return false;
0005942:     }
0005943:     X64Register register_index = (X64Register)register_number;
0005944:     BusterX86MetadataPhysicalOperand address_operands[2] = {
0005945:         codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(register_index, 64),
0005946:         codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_memory(X64_REGISTER_RSP, 64, offset),
0005947:     };
0005948:     if (!codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_emit(buffer, S8("LEA"), address_operands, BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(address_operands)))
0005949:     {
0005950:         return false;
0005951:     }
0005952:     if (alignment > CODEGEN_X64_STACK_ALIGNMENT)
0005953:     {
0005954:         BusterX86MetadataPhysicalOperand add_operands[2] = {
0005955:             codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(register_index, 64),
0005956:             codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_immediate(alignment - 1, 32),
0005957:         };
0005958:         BusterX86MetadataPhysicalOperand and_operands[2] = {
0005959:             codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(register_index, 64),
0005960:             codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_immediate(-(s64)alignment, 32),
0005961:         };
0005962:         if (!codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_emit(buffer, S8("ADD"), add_operands, BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(add_operands)) ||
0005963:             !codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_emit(buffer, S8("AND"), and_operands, BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(and_operands)))
0005964:         {
0005965:             return false;
0005966:         }
0005967:     }
0005968:     return buffer->error == CODEGEN_ERROR_NONE;
0005969: }
0005970: 
0005971: BUSTER_GLOBAL_LOCAL s32 codegen_canonical_x64_rebase_frame_displacement(CodegenBuffer* buffer, s64 displacement, u32 frame_base_offset)
0005972: {
0005973:     s64 rebased = (s64)frame_base_offset + displacement;
0005974:     if (rebased < INT32_MIN || rebased > INT32_MAX)
0005975:     {
0005976:         if (buffer)
0005977:         {
0005978:             buffer->error = CODEGEN_ERROR_CAPACITY;
0005979:         }
0005980:         return 0;
0005981:     }
0005982:     return (s32)rebased;
0005983: }
0005984: 
0005985: // The caller-owned copy of one indirectly passed argument, moved from its frame
0005986: // slot into the outgoing area an eightbyte at a time. An argument that wants
0005987: // more than the stack pointer's sixteen bytes of alignment is written through
0005988: // r11 instead, holding the rounded-up address of its over-reserved slot: r11 is
0005989: // volatile, carries no argument, and every copy re-materializes it.
0005990: BUSTER_GLOBAL_LOCAL bool codegen_canonical_x64_copy_frame_to_rsp(CodegenBuffer* buffer, u32 source_offset, u32 frame_base_offset,
0005991:                                                                  u32 destination_offset, u32 size, u32 alignment)
0005992: {
0005993:     if (!buffer || !size || source_offset > INT32_MAX || destination_offset > INT32_MAX)
0005994:     {
0005995:         return false;
0005996:     }
0005997:     bool through_scratch = alignment > CODEGEN_X64_STACK_ALIGNMENT;
0005998:     if (through_scratch)
0005999:     {
0006000:         if (!codegen_canonical_x64_rsp_address(buffer, X64_REGISTER_R11, destination_offset, alignment))
0006001:         {
0006002:             return false;
0006003:         }
0006004:         destination_offset = 0;
0006005:     }
0006006:     u64 copied = 0;
0006007:     while (copied < size)
0006008:     {
0006009:         u64 source_offset_within_value = (u64)source_offset + copied;
0006010:         u64 destination = (u64)destination_offset + copied;
0006011:         s32 source = codegen_canonical_x64_rebase_frame_displacement(buffer, -(s64)source_offset + (s64)copied, frame_base_offset);
0006012:         u32 chunk = codegen_canonical_copy_chunk((u64)size - copied, source_offset_within_value, destination);
0006013:         if (source_offset_within_value > INT32_MAX || destination > INT32_MAX || buffer->error != CODEGEN_ERROR_NONE)
0006014:         {
0006015:             return false;
0006016:         }
0006017:         u16 width = (u16)(chunk * 8);
0006018:         BusterX86MetadataPhysicalOperand load_operands[2] = {
0006019:             codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_RAX, chunk <= 2 ? 32 : width),
0006020:             codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_memory(X64_REGISTER_RBP, width, source),
0006021:         };
0006022:         String8 load_mnemonic = chunk <= 2 ? S8("MOVZX") : S8("MOV");
0006023:         if (!codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_emit(buffer, load_mnemonic, load_operands, BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(load_operands)))
0006024:         {
0006025:             return false;
0006026:         }
0006027:         BusterX86MetadataPhysicalOperand store_operands[2] = {
0006028:             codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_memory(through_scratch ? X64_REGISTER_R11 : X64_REGISTER_RSP, width, (s64)destination),
0006029:             codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_RAX, width),
0006030:         };
0006031:         if (!codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_emit(buffer, S8("MOV"), store_operands, BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(store_operands)))
0006032:         {
0006033:             return false;
0006034:         }
0006035:         copied += chunk;
0006036:     }
0006037:     return true;
0006038: }
0006039: 
0006040: // The reverse move: bytes a callee stored through an over-aligned
0006041: // outgoing-area slot come home to a value's frame slot an eightbyte at a
0006042: // time. R11 re-derives the rounded-up address the callee wrote through, the
0006043: // same way the slot's address was staged before the call.
0006044: BUSTER_GLOBAL_LOCAL bool codegen_canonical_x64_copy_rsp_to_frame(CodegenBuffer* buffer, u32 source_offset, u32 source_alignment,
0006045:                                                                  u32 destination_offset, u32 frame_base_offset, u32 size)
0006046: {
0006047:     if (!buffer || !size || destination_offset > INT32_MAX || size > INT32_MAX)
0006048:     {
0006049:         return false;
0006050:     }
0006051:     if (!codegen_canonical_x64_rsp_address(buffer, X64_REGISTER_R11, source_offset, source_alignment))
0006052:     {
0006053:         return false;
0006054:     }
0006055:     u64 copied = 0;
0006056:     while (copied < size)
0006057:     {
0006058:         s32 destination = codegen_canonical_x64_rebase_frame_displacement(buffer, -(s64)destination_offset + (s64)copied, frame_base_offset);
0006059:         u32 chunk = codegen_canonical_copy_chunk((u64)size - copied, copied, copied);
0006060:         if (buffer->error != CODEGEN_ERROR_NONE || copied > INT32_MAX)
0006061:         {
0006062:             return false;
0006063:         }
0006064:         u16 width = (u16)(chunk * 8);
0006065:         BusterX86MetadataPhysicalOperand load_operands[2] = {
0006066:             codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_RAX, chunk <= 2 ? 32 : width),
0006067:             codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_memory_relaxed(X64_REGISTER_R11, width, (s64)copied),
0006068:         };
0006069:         String8 load_mnemonic = chunk <= 2 ? S8("MOVZX") : S8("MOV");
0006070:         if (!codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_emit(buffer, load_mnemonic, load_operands, BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(load_operands)))
0006071:         {
0006072:             return false;
0006073:         }
0006074:         BusterX86MetadataPhysicalOperand store_operands[2] = {
0006075:             codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_memory(X64_REGISTER_RBP, width, destination),
0006076:             codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_RAX, width),
0006077:         };
0006078:         if (!codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_emit(buffer, S8("MOV"), store_operands, BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(store_operands)))
0006079:         {
0006080:             return false;
0006081:         }
0006082:         copied += chunk;
0006083:     }
0006084:     return true;
0006085: }
0006086: 
0006087: BUSTER_GLOBAL_LOCAL bool codegen_canonical_a64_float_memory_operation_base(CodegenBuffer* buffer, u32 register_number, u32 offset, u32 size, bool store,
0006088:                                                                            u32 base_register)
0006089: {
0006090:     // The b and h forms carry the one- and two-byte short vectors AAPCS64
0006091:     // hands the low bytes of a V register. Without them the HFA capture
0006092:     // path — whose part classification already routes a vector here —
0006093:     // emitted nothing at all and left the parameter's slot zero, since
0006094:     // its callers do not check this helper's result.
0006095:     u32 scale = size == 16 ? 16 : size == 8 ? 8 : size == 4 ? 4 : size == 2 ? 2 : size == 1 ? 1 : 0;
0006096:     if (!scale || offset % scale || register_number > 31)
0006097:     {
0006098:         return false;
0006099:     }
0006100:     bool indirect = offset / scale > A64_IMM12_MAX;
0006101:     if (indirect)
0006102:     {
0006103:         codegen_canonical_a64_base_address(buffer, 16, base_register, offset);
0006104:         offset = 0;
0006105:     }
0006106:     u32 instruction = store ? (size == 16   ? 0x3d8003e0
0006107:                                : size == 8  ? 0xfd0003e0
0006108:                                : size == 4  ? 0xbd0003e0
0006109:                                : size == 2  ? 0x7d0003e0
0006110:                                             : 0x3d0003e0)
0006111:                             : (size == 16   ? 0x3dc003e0
0006112:                                : size == 8  ? 0xfd4003e0
0006113:                                : size == 4  ? 0xbd4003e0
0006114:                                : size == 2  ? 0x7d4003e0
0006115:                                             : 0x3d4003e0);
0006116:     codegen_emit_u32(buffer, (instruction & ~(31u << 5)) | ((offset / scale) << 10) | ((indirect ? 16u : base_register) << 5) | register_number);
0006117:     return true;
0006118: }
0006119: 
0006120: BUSTER_GLOBAL_LOCAL bool codegen_canonical_a64_float_memory_operation(CodegenBuffer* buffer, u32 register_number, u32 offset, u32 size, bool store)
0006121: {
0006122:     return codegen_canonical_a64_float_memory_operation_base(buffer, register_number, offset, size, store, 31);
0006123: }
0006124: 
0006125: BUSTER_GLOBAL_LOCAL bool codegen_canonical_a64_frame_float_memory_operation(CodegenBuffer* buffer, u32 register_number, u32 offset, u32 size, bool store)
0006126: {
0006127:     return codegen_canonical_a64_float_memory_operation_base(buffer, register_number, offset, size, store, 28);
0006128: }

0006130: // Reconstruct an ELF va_arg from the ABI image named by X12. Indirect
0006131: // composites must read exactly their object bytes, including a short tail.
0006132: BUSTER_GLOBAL_LOCAL bool codegen_canonical_a64_va_value(CodegenBuffer* buffer, IrAbiValue* abi, u32 size,
0006133:     u32 part_count, u32 result_offset, bool from_registers)
0006134: {
0006135:     bool valid = true;
0006136:     bool floating = abi->part_count && codegen_canonical_abi_part_is_float(abi->parts[0].abi_class);
0006137:     if (abi->indirect)
0006138:     {
0006139:         valid = codegen_canonical_a64_memory_operation_base(buffer, 12, 0, 8, false, false, 12);
0006140:     }
0006141:     for (u32 part = 0; part < part_count && valid; part += 1)
0006142:     {
0006143:         u32 offset = floating ? abi->parts[part].value_offset : part * 8u;
0006144:         u32 source_offset = from_registers && floating ? part * 16u : offset;
0006145:         u32 remaining = abi->indirect ? size : floating ? abi->parts[part].size : 8u;
0006146:         u32 copied = 0;
0006147:         while (remaining && valid)
0006148:         {
0006149:             u32 chunk = remaining >= 8 ? 8u : remaining >= 4 ? 4u : remaining >= 2 ? 2u : 1u;
0006150:             valid = codegen_canonical_a64_memory_operation_base(buffer, 9, source_offset + copied, chunk, false, false, 12) &&
0006151:                     codegen_canonical_a64_frame_memory_operation(buffer, 9, result_offset + offset + copied, chunk, true, false);
0006152:             copied += chunk;
0006153:             remaining -= chunk;
0006154:         }
0006155:     }
0006156:     return valid;
0006157: }
0006158: 
0006159: BUSTER_GLOBAL_LOCAL bool codegen_canonical_a64_vector_operation(CodegenBuffer* buffer, IrProgram* program, IrFunction* function, IrInstruction* instruction,
0006160:                                                                 u32 const* value_offsets)
0006161: {
0006162:     if (!instruction->operand_count)
0006163:     {
0006164:         return false;
0006165:     }
0006166:     IrTypeId operand_type_id = function->values[instruction->operands[0].value].canonical_type;
0006167:     IrType* vector = ir_type_from_id(&program->types, operand_type_id);
0006168:     IrType* element = vector ? ir_type_from_id(&program->types, vector->element_type) : 0;
0006169:     if (!vector || vector->kind != IR_TYPE_VECTOR || !codegen_vector_element_supported(element) ||
0006170:         instruction->result.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || vector->element_count > UINT32_MAX)
0006171:     {
0006172:         return false;
0006173:     }
0006174:     u32 lane_size = element->bit_width / 8;
0006175:     if ((u64)lane_size * vector->element_count != vector->layout.size)
0006176:     {
0006177:         return false;
0006178:     }
0006179:     u32 left_base = value_offsets[instruction->operands[0].value];
0006180:     u32 right_base = instruction->operand_count == 2 ? value_offsets[instruction->operands[1].value] : 0;
0006181:     u32 result_base = value_offsets[instruction->result.value];
0006182:     bool comparison = instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_BINARY && instruction->binary_operation >= IR_BINARY_VECTOR_INTEGER_EQUAL &&
0006183:                       instruction->binary_operation <= IR_BINARY_VECTOR_FLOAT_GREATER_EQUAL;
0006184:     for (u32 lane = 0; lane < (u32)vector->element_count; lane += 1)
0006185:     {
0006186:         u32 lane_offset = lane * lane_size;
0006187:         u32 left_offset = left_base + lane_offset;
0006188:         u32 result_offset = result_base + lane_offset;
0006189:         if (instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_UNARY)
0006190:         {
0006191:             if (element->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT)
0006192:             {
0006193:                 if ((element->bit_width != 32 && element->bit_width != 64) || instruction->unary_operation != IR_UNARY_VECTOR_FLOAT_NEGATE ||
0006194:                     !codegen_canonical_a64_float_memory_operation(buffer, 0, left_offset, lane_size, false))
0006195:                 {
0006196:                     return false;
0006197:                 }
0006198:                 codegen_emit_u32(buffer, element->bit_width == 32 ? 0x1e214000 : 0x1e614000);
0006199:                 if (!codegen_canonical_a64_float_memory_operation(buffer, 0, result_offset, lane_size, true))
0006200:                 {
0006201:                     return false;
0006202:                 }
0006203:                 continue;
0006204:             }
0006205:             if (!codegen_canonical_a64_memory_operation(buffer, 9, left_offset, lane_size, false, false))
0006206:             {
0006207:                 return false;
0006208:             }
0006209:             u32 encoded = instruction->unary_operation == IR_UNARY_VECTOR_INTEGER_NEGATE        ? 0xcb0903e9
0006210:                           : instruction->unary_operation == IR_UNARY_VECTOR_INTEGER_BITWISE_NOT ? 0xaa2903e9
0006211:                                                                                                 : 0;
0006212:             if (!encoded)
0006213:             {
0006214:                 return false;
0006215:             }
0006216:             codegen_emit_u32(buffer, encoded);
0006217:             if (!codegen_canonical_a64_memory_operation(buffer, 9, result_offset, lane_size, true, false))
0006218:             {
0006219:                 return false;
0006220:             }
0006221:             continue;
0006222:         }
0006223:         if (instruction->operand_count != 2)
0006224:         {
0006225:             return false;
0006226:         }
0006227:         u32 right_offset = right_base + lane_offset;
0006228:         IrBinaryOperation operation = instruction->binary_operation;
0006229:         if (element->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT)
0006230:         {
0006231:             if ((element->bit_width != 32 && element->bit_width != 64) ||
0006232:                 !codegen_canonical_a64_float_memory_operation(buffer, 0, left_offset, lane_size, false) ||
0006233:                 !codegen_canonical_a64_float_memory_operation(buffer, 1, right_offset, lane_size, false))
0006234:             {
0006235:                 return false;
0006236:             }
0006237:             if (!comparison)
0006238:             {
0006239:                 u32 encoded = operation == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_FLOAT_ADD        ? 0x1e212800
0006240:                               : operation == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_FLOAT_SUBTRACT ? 0x1e213800
0006241:                               : operation == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_FLOAT_MULTIPLY ? 0x1e210800
0006242:                               : operation == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_FLOAT_DIVIDE   ? 0x1e211800
0006243:                                                                              : 0;
0006244:                 if (!encoded)
0006245:                 {
0006246:                     return false;
0006247:                 }
0006248:                 if (element->bit_width == 64)
0006249:                 {
0006250:                     encoded |= 0x00400000;
0006251:                 }
0006252:                 codegen_emit_u32(buffer, encoded);
0006253:                 if (!codegen_canonical_a64_float_memory_operation(buffer, 0, result_offset, lane_size, true))
0006254:                 {
0006255:                     return false;
0006256:                 }
0006257:                 continue;
0006258:             }
0006259:             codegen_emit_u32(buffer, element->bit_width == 32 ? 0x1e212000 : 0x1e612000);
0006260:             u32 condition = operation == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_FLOAT_EQUAL           ? 0
0006261:                             : operation == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_FLOAT_NOT_EQUAL     ? 1
0006262:                             : operation == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_FLOAT_LESS          ? 4
0006263:                             : operation == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_FLOAT_LESS_EQUAL    ? 9
0006264:                             : operation == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_FLOAT_GREATER       ? 12
0006265:                             : operation == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_FLOAT_GREATER_EQUAL ? 10
0006266:                                                                                 : UINT32_MAX;
0006267:             if (condition == UINT32_MAX)
0006268:             {
0006269:                 return false;
0006270:             }
0006271:             codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0x1a9f07e9 | ((condition ^ 1) << 12));
0006272:         }
0006273:         else
0006274:         {
0006275:             bool signed_semantics = operation == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_SIGNED_DIVIDE || operation == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_SIGNED_REMAINDER ||
0006276:                                     operation == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_SIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT ||
0006277:                                     (operation >= IR_BINARY_VECTOR_SIGNED_LESS && operation <= IR_BINARY_VECTOR_SIGNED_GREATER_EQUAL);
0006278:             if (!codegen_canonical_a64_memory_operation(buffer, 9, left_offset, lane_size, false, signed_semantics) ||
0006279:                 !codegen_canonical_a64_memory_operation(buffer, 10, right_offset, lane_size, false, signed_semantics))
0006280:             {
0006281:                 return false;
0006282:             }
0006283:             if (!comparison)
0006284:             {
0006285:                 u32 encoded = 0;
0006286:                 switch (operation)
0006287:                 {
0006288:                 case IR_BINARY_VECTOR_INTEGER_ADD:
0006289:                     encoded = 0x8b0a0129;
0006290:                     break;
0006291:                 case IR_BINARY_VECTOR_INTEGER_SUBTRACT:
0006292:                     encoded = 0xcb0a0129;
0006293:                     break;
0006294:                 case IR_BINARY_VECTOR_INTEGER_MULTIPLY:
0006295:                     encoded = 0x9b0a7d29;
0006296:                     break;
0006297:                 case IR_BINARY_VECTOR_SIGNED_DIVIDE:
0006298:                     encoded = 0x9aca0d29;
0006299:                     break;
0006300:                 case IR_BINARY_VECTOR_UNSIGNED_DIVIDE:
0006301:                     encoded = 0x9aca0929;
0006302:                     break;
0006303:                 case IR_BINARY_VECTOR_SIGNED_REMAINDER:
0006304:                     codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0x9aca0d2b);
0006305:                     encoded = 0x9b0aa569;
0006306:                     break;
0006307:                 case IR_BINARY_VECTOR_UNSIGNED_REMAINDER:
0006308:                     codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0x9aca092b); // udiv x11, x9, x10
0006309:                     encoded = 0x9b0aa569;
0006310:                     break;
0006311:                 case IR_BINARY_VECTOR_SHIFT_LEFT:
0006312:                     encoded = 0x9aca2129;
0006313:                     break;
0006314:                 case IR_BINARY_VECTOR_SIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT:
0006315:                     encoded = 0x9aca2929;
0006316:                     break;
0006317:                 case IR_BINARY_VECTOR_UNSIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT:
0006318:                     encoded = 0x9aca2529;
0006319:                     break;
0006320:                 case IR_BINARY_VECTOR_INTEGER_BITWISE_AND:
0006321:                     encoded = 0x8a0a0129;
0006322:                     break;
0006323:                 case IR_BINARY_VECTOR_INTEGER_BITWISE_OR:
0006324:                     encoded = 0xaa0a0129;
0006325:                     break;
0006326:                 case IR_BINARY_VECTOR_INTEGER_BITWISE_XOR:
0006327:                     encoded = 0xca0a0129;
0006328:                     break;
0006329:                 default:
0006330:                     return false;
0006331:                 }
0006332:                 codegen_emit_u32(buffer, encoded);
0006333:                 if (!codegen_canonical_a64_memory_operation(buffer, 9, result_offset, lane_size, true, false))
0006334:                 {
0006335:                     return false;
0006336:                 }
0006337:                 continue;
0006338:             }
0006339:             codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xeb0a013f);
0006340:             u32 encoded = operation == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_INTEGER_EQUAL            ? 0x1a9f17e9
0006341:                           : operation == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_INTEGER_NOT_EQUAL      ? 0x1a9f07e9
0006342:                           : operation == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_SIGNED_LESS            ? 0x1a9fa7e9
0006343:                           : operation == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_SIGNED_LESS_EQUAL      ? 0x1a9fc7e9
0006344:                           : operation == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_SIGNED_GREATER         ? 0x1a9fd7e9
0006345:                           : operation == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_SIGNED_GREATER_EQUAL   ? 0x1a9fb7e9
0006346:                           : operation == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_UNSIGNED_LESS          ? 0x1a9f27e9
0006347:                           : operation == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_UNSIGNED_LESS_EQUAL    ? 0x1a9f87e9
0006348:                           : operation == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_UNSIGNED_GREATER       ? 0x1a9f97e9
0006349:                           : operation == IR_BINARY_VECTOR_UNSIGNED_GREATER_EQUAL ? 0x1a9f37e9
0006350:                                                                                  : 0;
0006351:             if (!encoded)
0006352:             {
0006353:                 return false;
0006354:             }
0006355:             codegen_emit_u32(buffer, encoded);
0006356:         }
0006357:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xcb0903e9);
0006358:         if (!codegen_canonical_a64_memory_operation(buffer, 9, result_offset, lane_size, true, false))
0006359:         {
0006360:             return false;
0006361:         }
0006362:     }
0006363:     return true;
0006364: }
0006365: 
0006366: BUSTER_GLOBAL_LOCAL u8* codegen_canonical_direct_call_uses(Arena* arena, IrFunction* function)
0006367: {
0006368:     u8* uses = arena_allocate(arena, u8, function->value_count);
0006369:     memset(uses, 0, sizeof(*uses) * function->value_count);
0006370:     for (u32 instruction_index = 0; instruction_index < function->instruction_count; instruction_index += 1)
0006371:     {
0006372:         IrInstruction* instruction = function->instructions + instruction_index;
0006373:         for (u32 operand_index = 0; operand_index < instruction->operand_count; operand_index += 1)
0006374:         {
0006375:             IrValueId operand = instruction->operands[operand_index];
0006376:             if (operand.value >= function->value_count || uses[operand.value] == 2)
0006377:             {
0006378:                 continue;
0006379:             }
0006380:             bool direct = instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_CALL && operand_index == 0;
0006381:             if (direct)
0006382:             {
0006383:                 IrInstructionId definition = function->values[operand.value].definition;
0006384:                 IrInstruction* reference = definition.value < function->instruction_count ? function->instructions + definition.value : 0;
0006385:                 direct = reference && reference->opcode == IR_OPCODE_FUNCTION && reference->symbol.value == instruction->symbol.value;
0006386:             }
0006387:             uses[operand.value] = direct ? 1 : 2;
0006388:         }
0006389:     }
0006390:     return uses;
0006391: }
0006392: 
0006393: BUSTER_GLOBAL_LOCAL bool codegen_canonical_value_is_global_place(IrFunction* function, u32 value_index)
0006394: {
0006395:     bool result;
0006396:     if (!function || value_index >= function->value_count)
0006397:     {
0006398:         result = false;
0006399:     }
0006400:     else
0006401:     {
0006402:         IrInstructionId definition = function->values[value_index].definition;
0006403:         result = definition.value < function->instruction_count && function->instructions[definition.value].opcode == IR_OPCODE_GLOBAL;
0006404:     }
0006405: 
0006406:     return result;
0006407: }
0006408: 
0006409: // A branch whose target block was not placed when the branch was emitted. The
0006410: // generator records the field to overwrite and fills every one of them once
0006411: // the block offsets are known.
0006412: typedef struct CCanonicalBranchPatch CCanonicalBranchPatch;
0006413: struct CCanonicalBranchPatch
0006414: {
0006415:     IrBlockId target;
0006416:     IrBlockId predecessor;
0006417:     u32 offset;
0006418:     u32 secondary_offset;
0006419:     bool aarch64;
0006420:     bool conditional;
0006421:     bool label_address;
0006422:     u8 reserved[3];
0006423: };
0006424: 
0006425: // The per-function emission state the canonical generator's inner loop works
0006426: // against: the code buffer, the frame each canonical value owns a slot in, and
0006427: // the two records that survive between instructions -- the forwarded rax store
0006428: // and the pending branch patches. Gathering it here is what lets the load,
0006429: // store and address helpers below be ordinary functions instead of macros
0006430: // reaching into the generator's locals.
0006431: typedef struct CCanonicalEmitter CCanonicalEmitter;
0006432: struct CCanonicalEmitter
0006433: {
0006434:     CodegenBuffer* buffer;
0006435:     u32 const* value_offsets;
0006436:     u32 frame_base_offset;
0006437:     bool save_rbx;
0006438:     u32 rbx_save_offset;
0006439:     // Win64 owns RSI as a callee-saved register while the 128-bit integer
0006440:     // vocabulary names it as a scratch, so a Windows function containing one
0006441:     // parks RSI in a frame slot beside the RBX save.
0006442:     bool save_rsi;
0006443:     u32 rsi_save_offset;
0006444:     // Buffer position immediately after the last full-width rax store and the
0006445:     // frame displacement it wrote. While nothing else has been emitted, rax
0006446:     // still holds that slot, so reloading it is a no-op. Any other emission
0006447:     // moves the position and invalidates the record.
0006448:     u64 forwarded_store_end;
0006449:     s32 forwarded_store_displacement;
0006450:     IrBlockId current_block;
0006451:     CCanonicalBranchPatch* branch_patches;
0006452:     u32 branch_patch_count;
0006453:     u32 branch_patch_capacity;
0006454: };
0006455: 
0006456: // False only when the patch list is full, which the caller reports as a
0006457: // capacity error and retries with a larger reservation.
0006458: BUSTER_GLOBAL_LOCAL bool c_branch_patch_push(CCanonicalEmitter* emitter, CCanonicalBranchPatch patch)
0006459: {
0006460:     bool result;
0006461:     if (emitter->branch_patch_count >= emitter->branch_patch_capacity)
0006462:     {
0006463:         result = false;
0006464:     }
0006465:     else
0006466:     {
0006467:         patch.predecessor = emitter->current_block;
0006468:         emitter->branch_patches[emitter->branch_patch_count] = patch;
0006469:         emitter->branch_patch_count += 1;
0006470:         result = true;
0006471:     }
0006472: 
0006473:     return result;
0006474: }
0006475: 
0006476: BUSTER_GLOBAL_LOCAL s32 c_x64_frame_displacement(CCanonicalEmitter* emitter, u32 offset)
0006477: {
0006478:     return codegen_canonical_x64_rebase_frame_displacement(emitter->buffer, -(s64)offset, emitter->frame_base_offset);
0006479: }
0006480: 
0006481: // Branches to parameterized blocks pass through an out-of-line edge thunk.
0006482: // First capture every source into the frame tile, then publish destinations;
0006483: // no edge can overwrite a source needed by another assignment. Label-address
0006484: // relocations bypass thunks so address-taken block identity never changes.
0006485: BUSTER_GLOBAL_LOCAL u32 c_canonical_edge_thunk(CCanonicalEmitter* emitter, IrProgram* program, IrFunction* function,
0006486:                                               CCanonicalBranchPatch patch, u32 scratch_offset, u32 target_offset)
0006487: {
0006488:     CodegenBuffer* buffer = emitter->buffer;
0006489:     u32 start = (u32)buffer->count;
0006490:     IrPublishedCfg const* cfg = function->published_cfg;
0006491:     IrCfgEdge const* edge = ir_function_cfg_edge(function, patch.predecessor, patch.target);
0006492:     if (!edge || !cfg || patch.target.value >= cfg->block_count)
0006493:     {
0006494:         buffer->error = CODEGEN_ERROR_INVALID_IR;
0006495:     }
0006496:     IrCfgBlock const* target = cfg ? cfg->blocks + patch.target.value : 0;
0006497:     for (u32 pass = 0; pass < 2 && !buffer->error; pass += 1)
0006498:     {
0006499:         u32 cursor = 0;
0006500:         for (u32 index = 0; index < target->parameter_count && !buffer->error; index += 1)
0006501:         {
0006502:             IrCfgParameter const* parameter = cfg->parameters + target->parameter_offset + index;
0006503:             IrValueId incoming = cfg->arguments[edge->argument_offset + index];
0006504:             {
0006505:                 IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&program->types, parameter->canonical_type);
0006506:                 u64 bytes = (BUSTER_MAX(type->layout.size, (u64)8) + 7) & ~(u64)7;
0006507:                 u32 value = pass ? parameter->value.value : incoming.value;
0006508:                 for (u32 byte = 0; byte < bytes && !buffer->error; byte += 8)
0006509:                 {
0006510:                     if (patch.aarch64)
0006511:                     {
0006512:                         u32 value_offset = emitter->value_offsets[value] + byte;
0006513:                         u32 temp_offset = scratch_offset + cursor + byte;
0006514:                         if (!codegen_canonical_a64_frame_memory_operation(buffer, 9, pass ? temp_offset : value_offset, 8, false, false) ||
0006515:                             !codegen_canonical_a64_frame_memory_operation(buffer, 9, pass ? value_offset : temp_offset, 8, true, false))
0006516:                         {
0006517:                             if (!buffer->error)
0006518:                             {
0006519:                                 buffer->error = CODEGEN_ERROR_INVALID_IR;
0006520:                             }
0006521:                         }
0006522:                     }
0006523:                     else
0006524:                     {
0006525:                         s32 value_offset = c_x64_frame_displacement(emitter, emitter->value_offsets[value]) + (s32)byte;
0006526:                         s32 temp_offset = c_x64_frame_displacement(emitter, scratch_offset) + (s32)(cursor + byte);
0006527:                         codegen_canonical_x64_asm_load(buffer, X64_REGISTER_RAX, X64_REGISTER_RBP, (u32)(pass ? temp_offset : value_offset), 8);
0006528:                         codegen_canonical_x64_asm_store(buffer, X64_REGISTER_RBP, X64_REGISTER_RAX, (u32)(pass ? value_offset : temp_offset), 8);
0006529:                     }
0006530:                 }
0006531:                 cursor += (u32)bytes;
0006532:             }
0006533:         }
0006534:     }
0006535:     if (!buffer->error)
0006536:     {
0006537:         s64 delta = (s64)target_offset - (s64)buffer->count;
0006538:         if (patch.aarch64)
0006539:         {
0006540:             if ((delta & 3) || delta < -(1 << 27) || delta >= (1 << 27))
0006541:             {
0006542:                 buffer->error = CODEGEN_ERROR_CAPACITY;
0006543:             }
0006544:             else
0006545:             {
0006546:                 codegen_emit_u32(buffer, UINT32_C(0x14000000) | ((u32)(delta >> 2) & UINT32_C(0x03ffffff)));
0006547:             }
0006548:         }
0006549:         else
0006550:         {
0006551:             BusterX86MetadataPhysicalOperand operand = codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_relative(delta - 5, 32);
0006552:             codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_emit(buffer, S8("JMP"), &operand, 1);
0006553:         }
0006554:     }
0006555:     return start;
0006556: }
0006557: 
0006558: BUSTER_GLOBAL_LOCAL s32 c_x64_value_displacement(CCanonicalEmitter* emitter, IrValueId value_id)
0006559: {
0006560:     return c_x64_frame_displacement(emitter, emitter->value_offsets[value_id.value]);
0006561: }
0006562: 
0006563: // `register_opcode` is the ModRM byte the caller would have emitted; its
0006564: // register field names the destination. 0x85 is the plain rax reload, the only
0006565: // one the forwarded store can answer.
0006566: BUSTER_GLOBAL_LOCAL void c_x64_load(CCanonicalEmitter* emitter, u8 register_opcode, IrValueId value_id)
0006567: {
0006568:     s32 displacement = c_x64_value_displacement(emitter, value_id);
0006569:     if (register_opcode == 0x85 && emitter->buffer->count == emitter->forwarded_store_end && displacement == emitter->forwarded_store_displacement)
0006570:     {
0006571:         return;
0006572:     }
0006573:     codegen_canonical_x64_asm_load(emitter->buffer, (X64Register)((register_opcode >> 3) & 7), X64_REGISTER_RBP, (u32)displacement, 8);
0006574: }
0006575: 
0006576: BUSTER_GLOBAL_LOCAL void c_x64_load_high(CCanonicalEmitter* emitter, u8 register_opcode, IrValueId value_id)
0006577: {
0006578:     s32 displacement = c_x64_value_displacement(emitter, value_id);
0006579:     codegen_canonical_x64_asm_load(emitter->buffer, (X64Register)((register_opcode >> 3) & 7), X64_REGISTER_RBP, (u32)(displacement + 8), 8);
0006580: }
0006581: 
0006582: BUSTER_GLOBAL_LOCAL void c_x64_store_result(CCanonicalEmitter* emitter, s32 result_displacement)
0006583: {
0006584:     codegen_canonical_x64_asm_store(emitter->buffer, X64_REGISTER_RBP, X64_REGISTER_RAX, (u32)result_displacement, 8);
0006585:     if (!emitter->buffer->error)
0006586:     {
0006587:         emitter->forwarded_store_end = emitter->buffer->count;
0006588:         emitter->forwarded_store_displacement = result_displacement;
0006589:     }
0006590: }
0006591: 
0006592: BUSTER_GLOBAL_LOCAL void c_x64_store_high_rdx(CCanonicalEmitter* emitter, s32 result_displacement)
0006593: {
0006594:     codegen_canonical_x64_asm_store(emitter->buffer, X64_REGISTER_RBP, X64_REGISTER_RDX, (u32)(result_displacement + 8), 8);
0006595: }
0006596: 
0006597: // Leaves the addressed location in r10, either by loading the pointer value or
0006598: // by taking the address of the place's own frame slot.
0006599: BUSTER_GLOBAL_LOCAL void c_x64_atomic_address(CCanonicalEmitter* emitter, IrValueId place_id, bool indirect_place)
0006600: {
0006601:     if (indirect_place)
0006602:     {
0006603:         c_x64_load(emitter, 0x85, place_id);
0006604:         BusterX86MetadataPhysicalOperand move_operands[2] = {
0006605:             codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_R10, 64),
0006606:             codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_RAX, 64),
0006607:         };
0006608:         (void)codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_emit(emitter->buffer, S8("MOV"), move_operands, BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(move_operands));
0006609:     }
0006610:     else
0006611:     {
0006612:         BusterX86MetadataPhysicalOperand address_operands[2] = {
0006613:             codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_R10, 64),
0006614:             codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_memory(X64_REGISTER_RBP, 64, c_x64_value_displacement(emitter, place_id)),
0006615:         };
0006616:         (void)codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_emit(emitter->buffer, S8("LEA"), address_operands, BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(address_operands));
0006617:     }
0006618: }
0006619: 
0006620: BUSTER_GLOBAL_LOCAL void c_x64_load_float(CCanonicalEmitter* emitter, u32 register_index, IrValueId value_id, u32 width)
0006621: {
0006622:     BusterX86MetadataPhysicalOperand load_operands[2] = {
0006623:         codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_vector(register_index, (u16)width),
0006624:         codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_memory(X64_REGISTER_RBP, (u16)width, c_x64_value_displacement(emitter, value_id)),
0006625:     };
0006626:     String8 load_features[] = {width == 32 ? S8("sse") : S8("sse2")};
0006627:     (void)codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_emit_features(emitter->buffer, width == 32 ? S8("MOVSS") : S8("MOVSD"), load_operands,
0006628:                                                        BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(load_operands),
0006629:                                                        (BusterX86MetadataFeatureInput){.names = load_features,
0006630:                                                                                        .count = BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(load_features)});
0006631: }
0006632: 
0006633: BUSTER_GLOBAL_LOCAL void c_x64_restore_rbx(CCanonicalEmitter* emitter)
0006634: {
0006635:     if (emitter->save_rbx)
0006636:     {
0006637:         BusterX86MetadataPhysicalOperand restore_operands[2] = {
0006638:             codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_RBX, 64),
0006639:             codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_memory(X64_REGISTER_RBP, 64, c_x64_frame_displacement(emitter, emitter->rbx_save_offset)),
0006640:         };
0006641:         (void)codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_emit(emitter->buffer, S8("MOV"), restore_operands, BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(restore_operands));
0006642:     }
0006643:     if (emitter->save_rsi)
0006644:     {
0006645:         BusterX86MetadataPhysicalOperand restore_operands[2] = {
0006646:             codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_RSI, 64),
0006647:             codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_memory(X64_REGISTER_RBP, 64, c_x64_frame_displacement(emitter, emitter->rsi_save_offset)),
0006648:         };
0006649:         (void)codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_emit(emitter->buffer, S8("MOV"), restore_operands, BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(restore_operands));
0006650:     }
0006651: }
0006652:

0006654: {
0006655:     (void)codegen_canonical_a64_frame_memory_operation(emitter->buffer, register_number, emitter->value_offsets[value_id.value], 8, false, false);
0006656: }

0006659: // spelling of c_x64_load_high/c_x64_store_high_rdx. Only call these for

0006661: // not extend past its first eightbyte.
