0006676: 
0006677: // The AAPCS64 result image widens two compact integer-vector elements into
0006678: // 32-bit lanes and four elements into 16-bit lanes in D0. The canonical frame
0006679: // image remains compact. This predicate deliberately excludes single-lane
0006680: // short vectors, which retain their sized V-register transfer.
0006681: BUSTER_GLOBAL_LOCAL bool codegen_canonical_a64_widened_vector_result(IrProgram* program, IrType* type, u32* lane_count, u32* element_bits)
0006682: {
0006683:     IrType* element = type && type->kind == IR_TYPE_VECTOR ? ir_type_from_id(&program->types, type->element_type) : 0;
0006684:     bool result = type && type->layout.resolved && type->layout.size < 8 && element && element->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER &&
0006685:                   (type->element_count == 2 || type->element_count == 4) && (element->bit_width == 8 || element->bit_width == 16) &&
0006686:                   type->layout.size == type->element_count * (element->bit_width / 8);
0006687:     if (result)
0006688:     {
0006689:         *lane_count = (u32)type->element_count;
0006690:         *element_bits = element->bit_width;
0006691:     }
0006692:     return result;
0006693: }
0006694: 
0006695: // Convert X9 between the compact frame image and the widened D0 ABI image.
0006696: // X10 is the accumulating result and X11 is one extracted lane.
0006697: BUSTER_GLOBAL_LOCAL void codegen_canonical_a64_pack_vector_result(CodegenBuffer* buffer, u32 lane_count, u32 element_bits, bool compact)
0006698: {
0006699:     u32 abi_lane_bits = 64u / lane_count;
0006700:     u32 source_lane_bits = compact ? abi_lane_bits : element_bits;
0006701:     u32 result_lane_bits = compact ? element_bits : abi_lane_bits;
0006702:     codegen_emit_u32(buffer, UINT32_C(0xaa1f03ea)); // mov x10, xzr
0006703:     for (u32 lane = 0; lane < lane_count; lane += 1)
0006704:     {
0006705:         u32 source_offset = lane * source_lane_bits;
0006706:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, UINT32_C(0xd3400000) | (source_offset << 16) | ((source_offset + element_bits - 1u) << 10) |
0006707:                                      (9u << 5) | 11u); // ubfx x11, x9, #source_offset, #element_bits
0006708:         u32 result_offset = lane * result_lane_bits;
0006709:         if (result_offset)
0006710:         {
0006711:             codegen_emit_u32(buffer, UINT32_C(0xd3400000) | ((64u - result_offset) << 16) | ((63u - result_offset) << 10) |
0006712:                                          (11u << 5) | 11u); // lsl x11, x11, #result_offset
0006713:         }
0006714:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, UINT32_C(0xaa0b014a)); // orr x10, x10, x11
0006715:     }
0006716:     codegen_emit_u32(buffer, UINT32_C(0xaa0a03e9)); // mov x9, x10
0006717: }
0006718: 
0006719: // Patches one local AArch64 branch after its target has been emitted. The
0006720: // canonical emitter uses this for the fixed-shape loops inside one IR row;
0006721: // ordinary IR block branches continue through CCanonicalBranchPatch below.
0006722: BUSTER_GLOBAL_LOCAL bool codegen_canonical_a64_patch_local_branch(CodegenBuffer* buffer, u32 branch_offset, u32 target_offset, bool conditional)
0006723: {
0006724:     bool result = false;
0006725:     if (buffer && buffer->error == CODEGEN_ERROR_NONE && branch_offset <= UINT32_MAX - 4 && branch_offset + 4 <= buffer->count && target_offset <= UINT32_MAX)
0006726:     {
0006727:         s64 delta = (s64)target_offset - (s64)branch_offset;
0006728:         s64 minimum = conditional ? -(s64)(1 << 20) : -(s64)(1 << 27);
0006729:         s64 maximum = conditional ? (s64)(1 << 20) : (s64)(1 << 27);
0006730:         if ((delta & 3) || delta < minimum || delta >= maximum)
0006731:         {
0006732:             buffer->error = CODEGEN_ERROR_CAPACITY;
0006733:         }
0006734:         else
0006735:         {
0006736:             u32 instruction = 0;
0006737:             memcpy(&instruction, buffer->bytes + branch_offset, sizeof(instruction));
0006738:             u32 immediate_mask = conditional ? UINT32_C(0x00ffffe0) : UINT32_C(0x03ffffff);
0006739:             if (instruction & immediate_mask)
0006740:             {
0006741:                 // A local patch must start from the zero-immediate template;
0006742:                 // silently OR-ing onto an old displacement would corrupt the
0006743:                 // loop target while still producing a decodable branch.
0006744:                 buffer->error = CODEGEN_ERROR_INVALID_IR;
0006745:             }
0006746:             else
0006747:             {
0006748:                 u32 immediate = (u32)(delta >> 2);
0006749:                 instruction |= conditional ? (immediate & 0x7ffff) << 5 : immediate & 0x03ffffff;
0006750:                 memcpy(buffer->bytes + branch_offset, &instruction, sizeof(instruction));
0006751:                 result = true;
0006752:             }
0006753:         }
0006754:     }
0006755:     else if (buffer && buffer->error == CODEGEN_ERROR_NONE)
0006756:     {
0006757:         buffer->error = CODEGEN_ERROR_CAPACITY;
0006758:     }
0006759:     return result;
0006760: }
0006761: 
0006762: // Emits the canonical 128-bit divide/remainder loop. Inputs arrive in
0006763: // x9:x10 (dividend) and x11:x12 (divisor), low eightbyte first. The loop
0006764: // shifts one dividend bit into x13:x14, subtracts the divisor when the
0006765: // partial remainder is large enough, and accumulates the quotient in x0:x1.
0006766: // Signed operations normalize both operands before the loop and restore the
0006767: // quotient/remainder sign afterwards; unsigned operations use the same loop
0006768: // without that normalization. On success the selected result is x9:x10.
0006769: BUSTER_GLOBAL_LOCAL bool codegen_canonical_a64_i128_divide(CodegenBuffer* buffer, bool signed_division, bool remainder_result)
0006770: {
0006771:     bool result = false;
0006772:     if (buffer)
0006773:     {
0006774:         if (signed_division)
0006775:         {
0006776:             // x15/x16 retain the operand sign masks; the pair XOR/subtract
0006777:             // turns each negative operand into its unsigned magnitude.
0006778:             codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0x937ffd4f); // asr x15, x10, #63
0006779:             codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xca0f0129); // eor x9, x9, x15
0006780:             codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xca0f014a); // eor x10, x10, x15
0006781:             codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xeb0f0129); // subs x9, x9, x15
0006782:             codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xda0f014a); // sbc x10, x10, x15
0006783:             codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0x937ffd90); // asr x16, x12, #63
0006784:             codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xca10016b); // eor x11, x11, x16
0006785:             codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xca10018c); // eor x12, x12, x16
0006786:             codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xeb10016b); // subs x11, x11, x16
0006787:             codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xda10018c); // sbc x12, x12, x16
0006788:             codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xca1001f1); // eor x17, x15, x16
0006789:         }
0006790: 
0006791:         // x0:x1 quotient, x13:x14 partial remainder, x2 iteration count.
0006792:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xaa1f03e0); // mov x0, xzr
0006793:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xaa1f03e1); // mov x1, xzr
0006794:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xaa1f03ed); // mov x13, xzr
0006795:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xaa1f03ee); // mov x14, xzr
0006796:         a64_emit_constant_compact(buffer, 2, 128);
0006797:         u32 loop_offset = (u32)buffer->count;
0006798:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xab090129); // adds x9, x9, x9
0006799:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xba0a014a); // adcs x10, x10, x10
0006800:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xba0d01ad); // adcs x13, x13, x13
0006801:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xba0e01ce); // adcs x14, x14, x14
0006802:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xab000000); // adds x0, x0, x0
0006803:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xba010021); // adcs x1, x1, x1
0006804:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xeb0c01df); // cmp x14, x12
0006805:         u32 high_less_branch = (u32)buffer->count;
0006806:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0x54000003); // b.lo skip_subtract
0006807:         u32 high_greater_branch = (u32)buffer->count;
0006808:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0x54000008); // b.hi subtract
0006809:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xeb0b01bf); // cmp x13, x11
0006810:         u32 low_less_branch = (u32)buffer->count;
0006811:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0x54000003); // b.lo skip_subtract
0006812:         u32 subtract_offset = (u32)buffer->count;
0006813:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xeb0b01ad); // subs x13, x13, x11
0006814:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xda0c01ce); // sbc x14, x14, x12
0006815:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xb2400000); // orr x0, x0, #1
0006816:         u32 skip_subtract = (u32)buffer->count;
0006817:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xf1000442); // subs x2, x2, #1
0006818:         u32 loop_branch = (u32)buffer->count;
0006819:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0x54000001); // b.ne loop
0006820:         codegen_canonical_a64_patch_local_branch(buffer, high_less_branch, skip_subtract, true);
0006821:         codegen_canonical_a64_patch_local_branch(buffer, high_greater_branch, subtract_offset, true);
0006822:         codegen_canonical_a64_patch_local_branch(buffer, low_less_branch, skip_subtract, true);
0006823:         codegen_canonical_a64_patch_local_branch(buffer, loop_branch, loop_offset, true);
0006824: 
0006825:         if (signed_division)
0006826:         {
0006827:             if (remainder_result)
0006828:             {
0006829:                 codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xca0f01ad); // eor x13, x13, x15
0006830:                 codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xca0f01ce); // eor x14, x14, x15
0006831:                 codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xeb0f01ad); // subs x13, x13, x15
0006832:                 codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xda0f01ce); // sbc x14, x14, x15
0006833:             }
0006834:             else
0006835:             {
0006836:                 codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xca110000); // eor x0, x0, x17
0006837:                 codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xca110021); // eor x1, x1, x17
0006838:                 codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xeb110000); // subs x0, x0, x17
0006839:                 codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xda110021); // sbc x1, x1, x17
0006840:             }
0006841:         }
0006842:         if (remainder_result)
0006843:         {
0006844:             codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xaa0d03e9); // mov x9, x13
0006845:             codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xaa0e03ea); // mov x10, x14
0006846:         }
0006847:         else
0006848:         {
0006849:             codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xaa0003e9); // mov x9, x0
0006850:             codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xaa0103ea); // mov x10, x1
0006851:         }
0006852:         result = buffer->error == CODEGEN_ERROR_NONE;
0006853:     }
0006854:     return result;
0006855: }
0006856: 
0006857: // Converts an i128 pair in a frame slot to an AArch64 scalar FP value. The
0006858: // halves are converted as an unsigned magnitude, with an integer sticky-bit
0006859: // combine before the final double conversion. Converting the halves
0006860: // independently and adding them can double-round a halfway value (the low
0006861: // half's sticky bit would have been lost by ucvtf), so the common path first
0006862: // rounds a target-precision significand (53 bits for binary64, 24 for binary32)
0006863: // and scales it by the discarded-bit count.
0006864: // Signed inputs are made positive first and negated in FP after the magnitude
0006865: // has been formed. The final narrowing is done only once when the requested
0006866: // destination is float.
0006867: BUSTER_GLOBAL_LOCAL bool codegen_canonical_a64_i128_to_float(CodegenBuffer* buffer, u32 source_offset, u32 result_offset, u32 target_width,
0006868:                                                             bool signed_value)
0006869: {
0006870:     bool result = false;
0006871:     if (buffer && (target_width == 32 || target_width == 64) &&
0006872:         codegen_canonical_a64_frame_memory_operation(buffer, 9, source_offset, 8, false, false) &&
0006873:         codegen_canonical_a64_frame_memory_operation(buffer, 10, source_offset + 8, 8, false, false))
0006874:     {
0006875:         if (signed_value)
0006876:         {
0006877:             codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0x937ffd4f); // asr x15, x10, #63
0006878:             codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xca0f012d); // eor x13, x9, x15
0006879:             codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xca0f014e); // eor x14, x10, x15
0006880:             codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xeb0f01ad); // subs x13, x13, x15
0006881:             codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xda0f01ce); // sbc x14, x14, x15
0006882:         }
0006883:         else
0006884:         {
0006885:             codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xaa0903ed); // mov x13, x9
0006886:             codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xaa0a03ee); // mov x14, x10
0006887:         }
0006888:         // A zero high half is already a 64-bit conversion. Keeping it on a
0006889:         // separate path also avoids asking the pair-significand code below to
0006890:         // represent a shift outside the target format's range.
0006891:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xf10001df); // cmp x14, #0
0006892:         u32 direct_branch = (u32)buffer->count;
0006893:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0x54000001); // b.ne general
0006894: 
0006895:         // For a nonzero high half, E = floor(log2(value)) = 64 + h and the
0006896:         // target conversion discards shift = E - (p - 1) bits. x0 is the
0006897:         // high-half leading-zero count, x2 the discard count. The three paths
0006898:         // below form the top p bits (x0) and the round/sticky pair (x1/x4);
0006899:         // all then join at one nearest-even increment.
0006900:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xaa0d03e0); // mov x0, x13
0006901:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xaa1f03e2); // mov x2, xzr
0006902:         u32 direct_to_convert = (u32)buffer->count;
0006903:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0x14000000); // b convert
0006904: 
0006905:         u32 general_offset = (u32)buffer->count;
0006906:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xdac011c0); // clz x0, x14
0006907:         // p includes the hidden leading bit: 53 for binary64 and 24 for
0006908:         // binary32. Thus shift = (64 + h) - (p - 1) = bias - clz(high).
0006909:         a64_emit_constant_compact(buffer, 2, target_width == 64 ? 75 : 104);
0006910:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xcb000042); // sub x2, x2, x0
0006911:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xf101005f); // cmp x2, #64
0006912:         u32 low_branch = (u32)buffer->count;
0006913:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0x54000003); // b.lo low_path
0006914:         u32 shift64_branch = (u32)buffer->count;
0006915:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0x54000000); // b.eq shift64_path
0006916: 
0006917:         // shift > 64: the significand is high >> (shift - 64), the round bit
0006918:         // is immediately below it, and sticky includes the low half plus all
0006919:         // lower high-half bits. x3 is shift - 64 and x4 is the round-bit
0006920:         // position in the high half.
0006921:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xd1010043); // sub x3, x2, #64
0006922:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0x9ac325c0); // lsr x0, x14, x3
0006923:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xd1000464); // sub x4, x3, #1
0006924:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0x9ac425c1); // lsr x1, x14, x4
0006925:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0x92400021); // and x1, x1, #1
0006926:         a64_emit_constant_compact(buffer, 5, 64);
0006927:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xcb0400a5); // sub x5, x5, x4
0006928:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0x9ac521c5); // lsl x5, x14, x5
0006929:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xf100009f); // cmp x4, #0
0006930:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0x9a8503e5); // csel x5, xzr, x5, eq
0006931:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xf10000bf); // cmp x5, #0
0006932:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0x9a9f07e4); // cset x4, ne
0006933:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xf10001bf); // cmp x13, #0
0006934:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0x9a9f07e5); // cset x5, ne
0006935:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xaa050084); // orr x4, x4, x5
0006936:         u32 high_to_round = (u32)buffer->count;
0006937:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0x14000000); // b round
0006938: 
0006939:         u32 shift64_offset = (u32)buffer->count;
0006940:         // shift == 64: high is the candidate significand, bit 63 of low is
0006941:         // the round bit, and the remaining low bits are sticky.
0006942:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xaa0e03e0); // mov x0, x14
0006943:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xd37ffda1); // lsr x1, x13, #63
0006944:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0x92400021); // and x1, x1, #1
0006945:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xd37ff9a4); // lsl x4, x13, #1
0006946:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xf100009f); // cmp x4, #0
0006947:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0x9a9f07e4); // cset x4, ne
0006948:         u32 shift64_to_round = (u32)buffer->count;
0006949:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0x14000000); // b round
0006950: 
0006951:         u32 low_offset = (u32)buffer->count;
0006952:         // shift < 64: combine the top of high with low >> shift. Sticky is
0006953:         // all low bits below the round bit.
0006954:         a64_emit_constant_compact(buffer, 3, 64);
0006955:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xcb020063); // sub x3, x3, x2
0006956:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0x9ac321c0); // lsl x0, x14, x3
0006957:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0x9ac225a1); // lsr x1, x13, x2
0006958:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xaa010000); // orr x0, x0, x1
0006959:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xd1000443); // sub x3, x2, #1
0006960:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0x9ac325a1); // lsr x1, x13, x3
0006961:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0x92400021); // and x1, x1, #1
0006962:         a64_emit_constant_compact(buffer, 4, 65);
0006963:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xcb020084); // sub x4, x4, x2
0006964:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0x9ac421a4); // lsl x4, x13, x4
0006965:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xf100009f); // cmp x4, #0
0006966:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0x9a9f07e4); // cset x4, ne
0006967:         u32 low_to_round = (u32)buffer->count;
0006968:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0x14000000); // b round
0006969: 
0006970:         u32 round_offset = (u32)buffer->count;
0006971:         // Round to nearest, ties to even. x1 is the round bit, x4 the sticky
0006972:         // flag, and x0's low bit supplies the tie parity.
0006973:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0x92400005); // and x5, x0, #1
0006974:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xaa050084); // orr x4, x4, x5
0006975:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0x8a010084); // and x4, x4, x1
0006976:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0x91000405); // add x5, x0, #1
0006977:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0xf100009f); // cmp x4, #0
0006978:         codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0x9a8010a0); // csel x0, x5, x0, ne
0006979: 
0006980:         u32 convert_offset = (u32)buffer->count;
0006981:         if (target_width == 32)
0006982:         {
0006983:             // x0 has at most 24 significant bits here, so this conversion is
0006984:             // exact. Scale in binary32 directly; narrowing a rounded binary64
0006985:             // value would introduce a second rounding step.
0006986:             codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0x9e230000); // ucvtf s0, x0
0006987:             a64_emit_constant(buffer, 16, UINT64_C(0x3f800000)); // float 1.0
0006988:             codegen_emit_u32(buffer, 0x8b025e10); // add x16, x16, x2, lsl #23

0007092: // Which data section a global's bytes belong in. `const` is the frontend's
0007093: // answer and the read-only section is its usual home, but an object that
0007094: // carries a relocation cannot stay there: those bytes are written when the
0007095: // program is relocated, and in a shared object that write lands on a page the
0007096: // loader mapped read-only, which is a DT_TEXTREL the loader has to undo or
0007097: // refuse. Clang answers the same question with a fourth data section,
0007098: // `.data.rel.ro`; this writer has three, so a read-only object holding a
0007099: // relocation is laid out with the writable ones. Nothing in the C object model
0007100: // moves with it -- writing through a `const` lvalue is undefined either way --
0007101: // and a static link, whose relocations are all resolved before the program
0007102: // runs, cannot tell the difference.
0007103: BUSTER_GLOBAL_LOCAL bool codegen_global_is_read_only(IrGlobal* global)
0007104: {
0007105:     return global->is_read_only && !global->relocation_count && global->initializer_kind != IR_GLOBAL_INITIALIZER_SYMBOL_ADDRESS;
0007106: }

0010580:                         u32 register_parts = windows_indirect ? 1 : part_count;
0010581:                         if (windows_indirect)
0010582:                         {
0010583:                             u32 self_piece_size = 0;
0010584:                             u32 self_pieces = codegen_canonical_x64_windows_vector_argument_pieces(&target, argument_type, &self_piece_size);
0010585:                             if (!self_pieces)
0010586:                             {
0010587:                                 result.error = CODEGEN_ERROR_UNSUPPORTED_ABI;
0010588:                                 return result;
0010589:                             }
0010590:                             if (self_piece_size)
0010591:                             {
0010592:                                 // Gather the pieces in slot order: the leading
0010593:                                 // references still sit in their argument
0010594:                                 // registers (read before the stack-piece
0010595:                                 // copies clobber RDX, which is one of them),
0010596:                                 // the tail was stored past the shadow space.
0010597:                                 // Each piece's bytes land at its offset in the
0010598:                                 // parameter's frame slot.
0010599:                                 u32 available = register_index < register_count ? register_count - register_index : 0;
0010600:                                 u32 register_pieces = BUSTER_MIN(self_pieces, available);
0010601:                                 u64 argument_stack_offset = codegen_canonical_x64_stack_argument_offset(prior_stack_bytes, 8);
0010602:                                 for (u32 piece = 0; piece < self_pieces; piece += 1)
0010603:                                 {
0010604:                                     u64 piece_value_offset = (u64)piece * self_piece_size;
0010605:                                     if ((s64)result_displacement + (s64)piece_value_offset + self_piece_size > INT32_MAX)
0010606:                                     {
0010607:                                         result.error = CODEGEN_ERROR_CAPACITY;
0010608:                                         return result;
0010609:                                     }
0010610:                                     X64Register piece_pointer = X64_REGISTER_RAX;
0010611:                                     X64Register piece_data = X64_REGISTER_RDX;
0010612:                                     if (piece < register_pieces)
0010613:                                     {
0010614:                                         piece_pointer = (X64Register)registers[register_index + piece];
0010615:                                         piece_data = X64_REGISTER_RAX;
0010616:                                     }
0010617:                                     else
0010618:                                     {
0010619:                                         s64 slot_displacement =
0010620:                                             (s64)48 + (s64)argument_stack_offset + (s64)(piece - register_pieces) * 8;
0010621:                                         BusterX86MetadataPhysicalOperand piece_pointer_load_operands[2] = {
0010622:                                             codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_RAX, 64),
0010623:                                             codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_memory(
0010624:                                                 X64_REGISTER_RBP, 64,
0010625:                                                 codegen_canonical_x64_rebase_frame_displacement(&buffer, slot_displacement,
0010626:                                                                                                 canonical_x64_frame_base_offset)),
0010627:                                         };
0010628:                                         if (!codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_emit(&buffer, S8("MOV"), piece_pointer_load_operands,
0010629:                                                                                    BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(piece_pointer_load_operands)))
0010630:                                         {
0010631:                                             result.error = buffer.error;
0010632:                                             return result;
0010633:                                         }
0010634:                                     }
0010635:                                     for (u32 chunk = 0; chunk < self_piece_size / 8; chunk += 1)
0010636:                                     {
0010637:                                         BusterX86MetadataPhysicalOperand piece_load_operands[2] = {
0010638:                                             codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(piece_data, 64),
0010639:                                             codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_memory_relaxed(piece_pointer, 64, (s64)chunk * 8),
0010640:                                         };
0010641:                                         BusterX86MetadataPhysicalOperand piece_store_operands[2] = {
0010642:                                             codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_memory(
0010643:                                                 X64_REGISTER_RBP, 64, result_displacement + (s32)piece_value_offset + (s32)(chunk * 8)),
0010644:                                             codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(piece_data, 64),
0010645:                                         };
0010646:                                         if (!codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_emit(&buffer, S8("MOV"), piece_load_operands,
0010647:                                                                                    BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(piece_load_operands)) ||
0010648:                                             !codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_emit(&buffer, S8("MOV"), piece_store_operands,
0010649:                                                                                    BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(piece_store_operands)))
0010650:                                         {
0010651:                                             result.error = buffer.error;
0010652:                                             return result;
0010653:                                         }
0010654:                                     }
0010655:                                 }
0010656:                                 instruction_id.value = instruction_id.value == emitted_block->last_instruction.value ? IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID : instruction_id.value + 1;
0010657:                                 continue;
0010658:                             }
0010659:                         }
0010660:                         if (!aggregate)
0010661:                         {
0010662:                             IrType* parameter_type = ir_type_from_id(&program->types, instruction->canonical_type);
0010663:                             if (parameter_type && (parameter_type->kind == IR_TYPE_STRUCT || parameter_type->kind == IR_TYPE_UNION))
0010664:                             {
0010665:                                 result.error = CODEGEN_ERROR_UNSUPPORTED_ABI;
0010666:                                 return result;
0010667:                             }
0010668:                         }
0010669:                         if (system_v_memory || (system_v_register_aggregate ? register_index + system_v_integer_parts > register_count ||
0010670:                                                                                   float_register_index + system_v_float_parts > 8
0010671:                                                                             : register_index + register_parts > register_count))
0010672:                         {

0010675:                             // so skip the padding it left behind.

0010677:                                 prior_stack_bytes,

0010682:                                     codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_RAX, 64),

0010692:                                     return result;
0010693:                                 }

0010695:                                 {

0010700:                                     };

0010702:                                         codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_memory(X64_REGISTER_RBP, 64,

0010705:                                     };

0010707:                                                                                BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(indirect_part_load_operands)) ||

0010709:                                                                                BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(indirect_part_store_operands)))
0010710:                                     {
0010711:                                         result.error = buffer.error;
0010712:                                         return result;
0010713:                                     }
0010714:                                 }
0010715:                                 instruction_id.value = instruction_id.value == emitted_block->last_instruction.value ? IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID : instruction_id.value + 1;
0010716:                                 continue;
0010717:                             }
0010718:                             for (u32 part_index = 0; part_index < stack_part_count; part_index += 1)
0010719:                             {

0010721:                                     codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_RAX, 64),

0010723:                                         X64_REGISTER_RBP, 64,

0010730:                                                                           result_displacement + (s32)(part_index * 8)),

0010732:                                 };

0010734:                                                                            BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(stack_load_operands)) ||

0010736:                                                                            BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(stack_store_operands)))
0010737:                                 {
0010738:                                     result.error = buffer.error;
0010739:                                     return result;
0010740:                                 }
0010741:                             }
0010742:                             instruction_id.value = instruction_id.value == emitted_block->last_instruction.value ? IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID : instruction_id.value + 1;
0010743:                             continue;
0010744:                         }
0010745:                         if (windows_indirect)
0010746:                         {
0010747:                             u8 source_reg = registers[register_index];
0010748:                             for (u32 part_index = 0; part_index < part_count; part_index += 1)

0010764:                                 {
0010765:                                     result.error = buffer.error;
0010766:                                     return result;
0010767:                                 }
0010768:                             }
0010769:                             instruction_id.value = instruction_id.value == emitted_block->last_instruction.value ? IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID : instruction_id.value + 1;
0010770:                             continue;
0010771:                         }
0010772:                         for (u32 part_index = 0; part_index < part_count; part_index += 1)
0010773:                         {
0010774:                             if (system_v_register_aggregate && codegen_canonical_abi_part_is_float(argument_aggregate_abi.parts[part_index].abi_class))
0010775:                             {

0010777:                                 u32 part_size = argument_aggregate_abi.parts[part_index].size;
0010778:                                 if (!codegen_canonical_x64_float_memory(&buffer, target, float_register_index, result_displacement + (s32)part_offset, part_size, true))
0010779:                                 {

0010781:                                     return result;

0010785:                             }
0010786:                             u8 reg = registers[register_index++];
0010787:                             // Both ABIs leave the bits above a narrow integer
0010788:                             // argument's declared width unspecified in its

0010790:                             // zero-extended in its eightbyte slot, so the
0010791:                             // incoming register is normalized to its width
0010792:                             // before it is stored. Without this a `uint32_t`

0010794:                             // half into every 64-bit use of the slot -- an
0010795:                             // index, a pointer offset, a comparison.
0010796:                             u16 argument_bits = part_count == 1 && argument_type &&
0010797:                                                         (argument_type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER || argument_type->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN)
0010798:                                                     ? (u16)(argument_type->layout.size * 8)
0010799:                                                     : (u16)64;

0010801:                             {

0010805:                                 };

0010810:                                     return result;
0010811:                                 }

0010819:                             };

0010821:                                                                        BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(register_store_operands)))

0010824:                                 return result;
0010825:                             }
0010826:                         }
0010827:                     }
0010828:                     else if (instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_GLOBAL || instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_FUNCTION)
0010829:                     {

0010840:                                 return result;

0010843:                             instruction_id.value = instruction_id.value == emitted_block->last_instruction.value ? IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID : instruction_id.value + 1;
0010844:                             continue;
0010845:                         }

0010848:                         if (is_thread_local)

0010979:                                                                            BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(thread_pointer_load_operands)))
0010980:                                 {
0010981:                                     result.error = buffer.error;
0010982:                                     return result;
0010983:                                 }
0010984:                                 // Local-exec folds the offset into the lea's
0010985:                                 // displacement; initial-exec adds the GOT word
0010986:                                 // the loader wrote to the thread pointer
0010987:                                 // instead.  Both are one instruction over the
0010988:                                 // same register.
0010989:                                 BusterX86MetadataPhysicalOperand tls_value_address_operands[2] = {
0010990:                                     codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_RAX, 64),
0010991:                                     initial_exec ? codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_rip_relative(64, 0)
0010992:                                                  : codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_memory(X64_REGISTER_RAX, 64, 0),
0010993:                                 };
0010994:                                 u32 tls_relocation_offset = 0;
0010995:                                 if (!codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_emit_relocation(&buffer, initial_exec ? S8("ADD") : S8("LEA"),
0010996:                                                                                      tls_value_address_operands,
0010997:                                                                                      BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(tls_value_address_operands),
0010998:                                                                                      &tls_relocation_offset))
0010999:                                 {
0011000:                                     result.error = buffer.error;
0011001:                                     return result;
0011002:                                 }
0011003:                                 result.relocations[result.relocation_count++] = (CodegenModuleRelocation){
0011004:                                     .symbol = instruction->symbol,
0011005:                                     .offset = tls_relocation_offset,
0011006:                                     .kind = (u8)(initial_exec ? CODEGEN_MODULE_RELOCATION_X86_64_GOTTPOFF
0011007:                                                               : CODEGEN_MODULE_RELOCATION_X86_64_TPOFF32),
0011008:                                 };
0011009:                             }
0011010:                         }
0011011:                         else
0011012:                         {
0011013:                             // Under -fPIC an interposable symbol's address is
0011014:                             // loaded out of its GOT slot rather than computed
0011015:                             // from the instruction pointer: the slot is what
0011016:                             // every object in the image shares, so a
0011017:                             // definition that replaces this one replaces it
0011018:                             // here too. `mov` and `lea` take the same
0011019:                             // rip-relative operand, so only the mnemonic and
0011020:                             // the relocation family differ.
0011021:                             bool got_indirect = position_independent && ir_symbol_is_interposable(symbol);
0011022:                             BusterX86MetadataPhysicalOperand address_operands[2] = {
0011023:                                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_RAX, 64),
0011024:                                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_rip_relative(64, 0),
0011025:                             };
0011026:                             u32 address_relocation_offset = 0;
0011027:                             if (!codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_emit_relocation(&buffer, got_indirect ? S8("MOV") : S8("LEA"), address_operands,
0011028:                                                                                  BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(address_operands),
0011029:                                                                                  &address_relocation_offset))
0011030:                             {
0011031:                                 result.error = buffer.error;
0011032:                                 return result;
0011033:                             }
0011034:                             result.relocations[result.relocation_count++] = (CodegenModuleRelocation){
0011035:                                 .symbol = instruction->symbol,
0011036:                                 .offset = address_relocation_offset,
0011037:                                 .kind = (u8)(got_indirect ? CODEGEN_MODULE_RELOCATION_X86_64_GOTPCREL : CODEGEN_MODULE_RELOCATION_X86_64_PC32),
0011038:                             };
0011039:                         }
0011040:                         BusterX86MetadataPhysicalOperand global_store_operands[2] = {
0011041:                             codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_memory(X64_REGISTER_RBP, 64, result_displacement),
0011042:                             codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_RAX, 64),
0011043:                         };
0011044:                         if (!codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_emit(&buffer, S8("MOV"), global_store_operands,
0011045:                                                                    BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(global_store_operands)))
0011046:                         {
0011047:                             result.error = buffer.error;
0011048:                             return result;
0011049:                         }
0011050:                     }
0011051:                     else if (instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_LOAD || instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_ATOMIC_LOAD)
0011052:                     {
0011053:                         IrValue* place = function->values + instruction->operands[0].value;
0011054:                         IrInstruction* definition = function->instructions + place->definition.value;
0011055:                         u32 aggregate_parts = 0;
0011056:                         bool aggregate = codegen_canonical_integer_aggregate_parts(program, instruction->canonical_type, &aggregate_parts);
0011057:                         IrType* aggregate_type = aggregate ? ir_type_from_id(&program->types, instruction->canonical_type) : 0;
0011058:                         bool indirect = definition->opcode == IR_OPCODE_GLOBAL || definition->opcode == IR_OPCODE_INDEX ||
0011059:                                         definition->opcode == IR_OPCODE_FIELD || definition->opcode == IR_OPCODE_DEREFERENCE ||
0011060:                                         (definition->opcode == IR_OPCODE_LOCAL && place->alignment > 16);
0011061:                         IrType* loaded_value_type = ir_type_from_id(&program->types, instruction->canonical_type);
0011062:                         bool loaded_f80_opaque = codegen_canonical_x64_type_is_f80_bytes_cached(f80_cache, program, instruction->canonical_type) &&

0011065:                         {

0011068:                                 !codegen_canonical_x64_type_is_f80_x87_shape_cached(f80_cache, program, instruction->canonical_type))
0011069:                             {
0011070:                                 result.error = CODEGEN_ERROR_UNSUPPORTED_INSTRUCTION;
0011071:                                 return result;
0011072:                             }
0011073:                             if (indirect)
0011074:                             {
0011075:                                 c_x64_load(&emitter, 0x85, instruction->operands[0]);
0011076:                                 if (!codegen_canonical_x64_emit_f80_copy(&buffer, X64_REGISTER_RAX, 0, X64_REGISTER_RBP, result_displacement,
0011077:                                                                           &x87_stack_depth))
0011078:                                 {
0011079:                                     result.error = buffer.error != CODEGEN_ERROR_NONE ? buffer.error : CODEGEN_ERROR_UNSUPPORTED_INSTRUCTION;
0011080:                                     return result;
0011081:                                 }
0011082:                             }
0011083:                             else if (!codegen_canonical_x64_emit_f80_copy(

0011086:                             {
0011087:                                 result.error = buffer.error != CODEGEN_ERROR_NONE ? buffer.error : CODEGEN_ERROR_UNSUPPORTED_INSTRUCTION;
0011088:                                 return result;
0011089:                             }

0011091:                             continue;

0011118:                                                                                          BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(atomic_load_operands)))
0011119:                                 {
0011120:                                     result.error = buffer.error != CODEGEN_ERROR_NONE ? buffer.error : CODEGEN_ERROR_UNSUPPORTED_INSTRUCTION;
0011121:                                     return result;
0011122:                                 }

0011125:                                 continue;
0011126:                             }

0011130:                             if (!aggregate_type || (aggregate_type->kind != IR_TYPE_INTEGER && !aggregate_kind) || atomic_width != 16 ||
0011131:                                 loaded_size <= 8 || loaded_size > 16 || !target_cpu_feature_has(target, TARGET_CPU_FEATURE_X86_CX16))
0011132:                             {
0011133:                                 result.error = CODEGEN_ERROR_UNSUPPORTED_INSTRUCTION;
0011134:                                 return result;
0011135:                             }
0011136:                             c_x64_atomic_address(&emitter, instruction->operands[0], indirect);
0011137:                             BusterX86MetadataPhysicalOperand zero_rax_operands[2] = {
0011138:                                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_RAX, 32),
0011139:                                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_RAX, 32),
0011140:                             };

0011144:                             };

0011148:                                                                      BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(zero_rdx_operands)))
0011149:                             {
0011150:                                 result.error = buffer.error != CODEGEN_ERROR_NONE ? buffer.error : CODEGEN_ERROR_UNSUPPORTED_INSTRUCTION;
0011151:                                 return result;
0011152:                             }
0011153:                             u32 retry = (u32)buffer.count;
0011154:                             BusterX86MetadataPhysicalOperand move_rax_to_rbx_operands[2] = {
0011155:                                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_RBX, 64),
0011156:                                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_RAX, 64),
0011157:                             };

0011159:                                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_RCX, 64),
0011160:                                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_RDX, 64),
0011161:                             };
0011162:                             if (!codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_emit(&buffer, S8("MOV"), move_rax_to_rbx_operands,
0011163:                                                                        BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(move_rax_to_rbx_operands)) ||

0011166:                             {
0011167:                                 result.error = buffer.error != CODEGEN_ERROR_NONE ? buffer.error : CODEGEN_ERROR_UNSUPPORTED_INSTRUCTION;
0011168:                                 return result;
0011169:                             }
0011170:                             BusterX86MetadataPhysicalOperand atomic_memory =
0011171:                                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_memory_relaxed(X64_REGISTER_R10, 128, 0);
0011172:                             String8 cx16_features_names[] = {S8("cx16")};
0011173:                             if (!codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_emit_attributes(
0011174:                                     &buffer, S8("CMPXCHG16B"), &atomic_memory, 1,

0011176:                                                                      .count = BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(cx16_features_names)},

0011178:                             {
0011179:                                 result.error = buffer.error != CODEGEN_ERROR_NONE ? buffer.error : CODEGEN_ERROR_UNSUPPORTED_INSTRUCTION;
0011180:                                 return result;
0011181:                             }

0011183:                             // The branch is emitted with a neutral rel32 and patched after the metadata encoder reports its
0011184:                             // exact length.  Keep the retry displacement as the only hand-written field in this sequence.
0011185:                             u32 retry_branch_offset = (u32)buffer.count;
0011186:                             if (!codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_emit(&buffer, S8("JNZ"), &retry_operand, 1))
0011187:                             {

0011189:                                 return result;
0011190:                             }

0011192:                             if (retry_delta < INT32_MIN || retry_delta > INT32_MAX || !buffer.bytes || retry_branch_offset + 6 > buffer.count)

0011200:                             c_x64_store_result(&emitter, result_displacement);

0011202:                             instruction_id.value = instruction_id.value == emitted_block->last_instruction.value ? IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID : instruction_id.value + 1;
0011203:                             continue;
0011204:                         }
0011205:                         if (aggregate)
0011206:                         {
0011207:                             if (!aggregate_type || !aggregate_type->layout.resolved)
0011208:                             {
0011209:                                 result.error = CODEGEN_ERROR_INVALID_IR;
0011210:                                 return result;
0011211:                             }
0011212:                             if (indirect)
0011213:                             {
0011214:                                 c_x64_load(&emitter, 0x95, instruction->operands[0]);
0011215:                                 if (buffer.error)
0011216:                                 {
0011217:                                     result.error = buffer.error;
0011218:                                     return result;
0011219:                                 }
0011220:                             }

0011345:                         c_x64_load(&emitter, 0x8d, instruction->operands[1]);

0011349:                         {
0011350:                             result.error = CODEGEN_ERROR_INVALID_IR;
0011351:                             return result;
0011352:                         }

0012867:                         BusterX86MetadataPhysicalOperand constant_value =
0012868:                             constant_width == 32 && immediate > UINT32_MAX
0012869:                                 ? codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_immediate((s64)(s32)(u32)immediate, constant_width)
0012870:                                 : codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_unsigned_immediate(immediate, constant_width);
0012871:                         BusterX86MetadataPhysicalOperand constant_operands[2] = {
0012872:                             codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_RAX, constant_width),
0012873:                             constant_value,
0012874:                         };
0012875:                         if (!codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_emit(&buffer, S8("MOV"), constant_operands,
0012876:                                                                    BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(constant_operands)))
0012877:                         {
0012878:                             result.error = buffer.error;
0012879:                             return result;
0012880:                         }
0012881:                         c_x64_store_result(&emitter, result_displacement);
0012882:                         if (instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_CONSTANT_INTEGER && constant_type && constant_type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER &&
0012883:                             constant_type->bit_width == 128)
0012884:                         {
0012885:                             BusterX86MetadataPhysicalOperand high_constant_operands[2] = {
0012886:                                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_RDX, 64),
0012887:                                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_unsigned_immediate(
0012888:                                     instruction->immediate_count > 1 ? instruction->immediates[1]
0012889:                                                                       : instruction->immediate_is_negative ? UINT64_MAX : 0,
0012890:                                     64),
0012891:                             };
0012892:                             if (!codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_emit(&buffer, S8("MOV"), high_constant_operands,
0012893:                                                                        BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(high_constant_operands)))
0012894:                             {
0012895:                                 result.error = buffer.error;
0012896:                                 return result;
0012897:                             }
0012898:                             c_x64_store_high_rdx(&emitter, result_displacement);
0012899:                         }
0012900:                     }
0012901:                     else if (instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_VA_START)
0012902:                     {
0012903:                         if (!canonical_variadic)
0012904:                         {
0012905:                             result.error = CODEGEN_ERROR_INVALID_IR;
0012906:                             return result;
0012907:                         }
0012908:                         u32 va_list_component_count = codegen_canonical_va_list_component_count(program, instruction->canonical_type);
0012909:                         if (!va_list_component_count)
0012910:                         {
0012911:                             result.error = CODEGEN_ERROR_INVALID_IR;
0012912:                             return result;
0012913:                         }
0012914:                         u32 gp_count = 0;
0012915:                         u32 fp_count = 0;
0012916:                         u32 stack_parts = 0;
0012917:                         for (u32 parameter_index = 0; parameter_index < canonical_function_type->parameter_count; parameter_index += 1)
0012918:                         {
0012919:                             IrTypeId parameter_type_id = canonical_function_type->parameter_types[parameter_index];
0012920:                             IrType* parameter_type = ir_type_from_id(&program->types, parameter_type_id);
0012921:                             if (codegen_canonical_x64_type_contains_f80_cached(f80_cache, program, parameter_type_id))
0012922:                             {
0012923:                                 result.error = CODEGEN_ERROR_UNSUPPORTED_INSTRUCTION;
0012924:                                 return result;
0012925:                             }

0012928:                             if (parameter_type && parameter_type->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT)
0012929:                             {
0012930:                                 if (fp_count < 8)
0012931:                                 {
0012932:                                     fp_count += 1;
0012933:                                 }
0012934:                                 else
0012935:                                 {
0012936:                                     stack_parts += 1;
0012937:                                 }
0012938:                             }
0012939:                             else if (aggregate ? gp_count + parts <= 6 : gp_count < 6)
0012940:                             {
0012941:                                 gp_count += parts;
0012942:                             }
0012943:                             else
0012944:                             {
0012945:                                 stack_parts += parts;
0012946:                             }
0012947:                         }
0012948:                         if (result.abi == CODEGEN_ABI_X86_64_SYSTEM_V)
0012949:                         {

0012951:                             BusterX86MetadataPhysicalOperand va_offsets_operands[2] = {
0012952:                                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_RAX, 64),
0012953:                                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_unsigned_immediate(offsets, 64),
0012954:                             };

0012956:                                                                       BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(va_offsets_operands));

0012959:                                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_RAX, 64),
0012960:                                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_memory(X64_REGISTER_RBP, 64, 16 + (s64)stack_parts * 8),
0012961:                             };

0012963:                                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_memory(X64_REGISTER_RBP, 64, (s64)result_displacement + 8),
0012964:                                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_RAX, 64),
0012965:                             };

0012967:                                                                       BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(va_overflow_address_operands));

0012969:                                                                       BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(va_overflow_store_operands));
0012970:                             BusterX86MetadataPhysicalOperand va_register_save_address_operands[2] = {
0012971:                                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_RAX, 64),
0012972:                                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_memory(
0012973:                                     X64_REGISTER_RBP, 64,
0012974:                                     codegen_canonical_x64_rebase_frame_displacement(&buffer, canonical_va_save_displacement,
0012975:                                                                                      canonical_x64_frame_base_offset)),
0012976:                             };
0012977:                             (void)codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_emit(&buffer, S8("LEA"), va_register_save_address_operands,
0012978:                                                                       BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(va_register_save_address_operands));
0012979:                         }
0012980:                         else
0012981:                         {
0012982:                             // The variadic tail starts after the named
0012983:                             // parameters' slots. Most named parameters take
0012984:                             // one slot; a pieced vector takes one per piece.
0012985:                             u64 named_slots = windows_indirect_return ? 1 : 0;
0012986:                             for (u32 named_index = 0; named_index < canonical_function_type->parameter_count; named_index += 1)
0012987:                             {
0012988:                                 u64 named_piece_count = 1;

0012990:                                     program, canonical_function_type->parameter_types[named_index], result.abi, false, false);
0012991:                                 if (named_abi.indirect)
0012992:                                 {

0012996:                                         &named_piece_size);
0012997:                                     if (named_pieces)
0012998:                                     {

0013000:                                     }
0013001:                                 }
0013002:                                 named_slots += named_piece_count;
0013003:                             }
0013004:                             BusterX86MetadataPhysicalOperand va_windows_address_operands[2] = {
0013005:                                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_RAX, 64),
0013006:                                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_memory(
0013007:                                     X64_REGISTER_RBP, 64,
0013008:                                     codegen_canonical_x64_rebase_frame_displacement(&buffer, 16 + (s64)named_slots * 8,
0013009:                                                                                      canonical_x64_frame_base_offset)),
0013010:                             };
0013011:                             (void)codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_emit(&buffer, S8("LEA"), va_windows_address_operands,
0013012:                                                                       BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(va_windows_address_operands));
0013013:                         }

0013015:                             codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_memory(
0013016:                                 X64_REGISTER_RBP, 64, (s64)result_displacement + (result.abi == CODEGEN_ABI_X86_64_SYSTEM_V ? 16 : 0)),

0013021:                             codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_RAX, 32),
0013022:                         };

0013024:                                                                   BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(va_save_area_operands));

0013026:                                                                   BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(va_zero_operands));

0013033:                             };

0013035:                                                                       BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(va_zero_store_operands));
0013036:                         }
0013037:                     }
0013038:                     else if (instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_VA_COPY)
0013039:                     {
0013040:                         u32 va_list_component_count = codegen_canonical_va_list_component_count(program, instruction->canonical_type);

0013044:                             return result;

0013060:                                                                       BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(va_copy_store_operands));
0013061:                         }
0013062:                     }
0013063:                     else if (instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_VA_END)
0013064:                     {
0013065:                         // va_end is a semantic lifetime marker.  The native
0013066:                         // representations used here do not require a
0013067:                         // destructive operation, and writing a fixed fourth
0013068:                         // word would exceed pointer-sized Windows va_list
0013069:                         // objects.
0013070:                     }
0013071:                     else if (instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_VA_ARG)
0013072:                     {
0013073:                         IrType* value_type = ir_type_from_id(&program->types, instruction->canonical_type);
0013074:                         // An aggregate that merely carries an f80 payload
0013075:                         // crosses the boundary as ordinary eightbytes -- musl's
0013076:                         // `union ldshape` rides two general-purpose registers --
0013077:                         // so it reads back through the generic path below.  A
0013078:                         // value whose own classification is the X87/X87_UP pair
0013079:                         // does not: System V sends that pair to memory, so the
0013080:                         // caller left it in a sixteen-aligned overflow slot and
0013081:                         // never in the register save area, and its read is the
0013082:                         // overflow arm alone.
0013083:                         bool va_arg_f80_opaque = result.abi == CODEGEN_ABI_X86_64_SYSTEM_V &&
0013084:                                                  codegen_canonical_x64_type_is_f80_opaque_cached(f80_cache, program, instruction->canonical_type);
0013085:                         if (!va_arg_f80_opaque && codegen_canonical_x64_type_contains_f80_cached(f80_cache, program, instruction->canonical_type))
0013086:                         {
0013087:                             if (!value_type || value_type->layout.size != 16 || result.abi != CODEGEN_ABI_X86_64_SYSTEM_V ||
0013088:                                 !codegen_canonical_x64_type_is_f80_x87_shape_cached(f80_cache, program, instruction->canonical_type))
0013089:                             {
0013090:                                 result.error = CODEGEN_ERROR_UNSUPPORTED_INSTRUCTION;
0013091:                                 return result;
0013092:                             }
0013093:                             // Realign the overflow cursor to the sixteen the
0013094:                             // caller placed the value at, take the slot, and
0013095:                             // advance past it.  The payload is then copied
0013096:                             // through the x87 stack the way every other f80
0013097:                             // copy here is, which is what leaves the six
0013098:                             // padding bytes of the destination zeroed rather
0013099:                             // than carrying whatever the caller's slot held.
0013100:                             // The copy's own scratch is RAX, so the va_list
0013101:                             // object is finished with before it runs.
0013102:                             c_x64_load(&emitter, 0x85, instruction->operands[0]);

0013105:                                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_memory(X64_REGISTER_RAX, 64, 8),
0013106:                             };
0013107:                             BusterX86MetadataPhysicalOperand f80_align_add_operands[2] = {
0013108:                                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_RDX, 64),
0013109:                                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_immediate(15, 8),
0013110:                             };
0013111:                             BusterX86MetadataPhysicalOperand f80_align_and_operands[2] = {
0013112:                                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_RDX, 64),
0013113:                                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_immediate(-16, 8),
0013114:                             };
0013115:                             BusterX86MetadataPhysicalOperand f80_cursor_store_operands[2] = {
0013116:                                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_memory(X64_REGISTER_RAX, 64, 8),
0013117:                                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_RDX, 64),
0013118:                             };

0013120:                                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_memory(X64_REGISTER_RAX, 64, 8),
0013121:                                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_immediate((s64)value_type->layout.size, 32),
0013122:                             };
0013123:                             if (!codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_emit(&buffer, S8("MOV"), f80_overflow_load_operands,
0013124:                                                                        BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(f80_overflow_load_operands)) ||
0013125:                                 !codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_emit(&buffer, S8("ADD"), f80_align_add_operands,
0013126:                                                                        BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(f80_align_add_operands)) ||
0013127:                                 !codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_emit(&buffer, S8("AND"), f80_align_and_operands,
0013128:                                                                        BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(f80_align_and_operands)) ||
0013129:                                 !codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_emit(&buffer, S8("MOV"), f80_cursor_store_operands,
0013130:                                                                        BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(f80_cursor_store_operands)) ||
0013131:                                 !codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_emit(&buffer, S8("ADD"), f80_cursor_advance_operands,
0013132:                                                                        BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(f80_cursor_advance_operands)) ||
0013133:                                 !codegen_canonical_x64_emit_f80_copy(&buffer, X64_REGISTER_RDX, 0, X64_REGISTER_RBP, result_displacement,
0013134:                                                                        &x87_stack_depth))
0013135:                             {
0013136:                                 result.error = buffer.error != CODEGEN_ERROR_NONE ? buffer.error : CODEGEN_ERROR_UNSUPPORTED_INSTRUCTION;
0013137:                                 return result;
0013138:                             }
0013139:                             instruction_id.value = instruction_id.value == emitted_block->last_instruction.value ? IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID : instruction_id.value + 1;
0013140:                             continue;
0013141:                         }
0013142:                         u32 integer_parts = 0;
0013143:                         bool aggregate = codegen_canonical_integer_aggregate_parts(program, instruction->canonical_type, &integer_parts);
0013144:                         bool floating = value_type && value_type->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT;
0013145:                         CodegenCanonicalAbiValue aggregate_abi = codegen_canonical_aggregate_abi(program, instruction->canonical_type, result.abi, false, true);
0013146:                         if (!value_type || !value_type->layout.size || value_type->layout.size > 16 ||
0013147:                             (!aggregate && !floating && value_type->kind != IR_TYPE_INTEGER && value_type->kind != IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN &&

0013149:                         {
0013150:                             result.error = CODEGEN_ERROR_UNSUPPORTED_INSTRUCTION;
0013151:                             return result;
0013152:                         }
0013153:                         c_x64_load(&emitter, 0x85, instruction->operands[0]);
0013154:                         bool split_system_v_aggregate =
0013155:                             result.abi == CODEGEN_ABI_X86_64_SYSTEM_V && aggregate_abi.part_count && !aggregate_abi.memory && !aggregate_abi.indirect;
0013156:                         u32 split_integer_count = 0;

0013190:                                                                            BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(gp_offset_compare_operands)))

0013193:                                     return result;
0013194:                                 }

0013200:                                     return result;

0013207:                                 }

0013209:                                 overflow_branch_sizes[overflow_branch_count] = branch_size;
0013210:                                 overflow_branch_count += 1;
0013211:                             }
0013212:                             BusterX86MetadataPhysicalOperand fp_offset_load_operands[2] = {
0013213:                                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_R8, 32),
0013214:                                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_memory_relaxed(X64_REGISTER_RAX, 32, 4),
0013215:                             };
0013216:                             BusterX86MetadataPhysicalOperand fp_offset_compare_operands[2] = {
0013217:                                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_R8, 32),
0013218:                                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_immediate(176 - split_float_count * 16, 32),

0013242:                             overflow_branch_sizes[overflow_branch_count] = fp_branch_size;
0013243:                             overflow_branch_count += 1;
0013244: 
0013245:                             BusterX86MetadataPhysicalOperand register_save_area_load_operands[2] = {
0013246:                                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_RDX, 64),
0013247:                                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_memory_relaxed(X64_REGISTER_RAX, 64, 16),
0013248:                             };
0013249:                             if (!codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_emit(&buffer, S8("MOV"), register_save_area_load_operands,
0013250:                                                                        BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(register_save_area_load_operands)))
0013251:                             {

0013613:                         u32 argument_count = call_layout.argument_count;
0013614:                         CodegenCanonicalCallArgument* arguments = call_layout.arguments;
0013615:                         CodegenCanonicalAbiValue call_return_abi = call_layout.return_abi;
0013616:                         bool call_windows_indirect_return = call_layout.windows_indirect_return;
0013617:                         bool call_x64_indirect_return = call_layout.indirect_return;
0013618:                         u32 simulated_float_registers = call_layout.simulated_float_registers;
0013619:                         // An argument wanting more than the sixteen bytes the
0013620:                         // stack pointer is already worth cannot be reached by
0013621:                         // pushing: where the pushes leave it depends on where
0013622:                         // the stack happened to be. Such a call moves the stack
0013623:                         // pointer down to the alignment the area needs instead,
0013624:                         // writes each argument at its own offset within it, and
0013625:                         // puts the stack pointer back from a frame slot after,
0013626:                         // which is the one restore an `and` cannot undo and a
0013627:                         // dynamically grown stack does not invalidate.
0013628:                         bool system_v_aligned_area = result.abi == CODEGEN_ABI_X86_64_SYSTEM_V && call_layout.stack_part_count &&
0013629:                                                      call_layout.stack_alignment > CODEGEN_X64_STACK_ALIGNMENT;
0013630:                         if (system_v_aligned_area && !x64_stack_save_offset)
0013631:                         {
0013632:                             result.error = CODEGEN_ERROR_UNSUPPORTED_ABI;
0013633:                             return result;
0013634:                         }
0013635:                         bool stack_padding = call_layout.stack_padding && !system_v_aligned_area;
0013636:                         if (stack_padding)
0013637:                         {
0013638:                             BusterX86MetadataPhysicalOperand stack_padding_operands[2] = {
0013639:                                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_RSP, 64),
0013640:                                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_immediate(8, 8),
0013641:                             };
0013642:                             if (!codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_emit(&buffer, S8("SUB"), stack_padding_operands,
0013643:                                                                        BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(stack_padding_operands)))
0013644:                             {
0013645:                                 result.error = buffer.error;
0013646:                                 return result;
0013647:                             }
0013648:                         }

0013650:                         {

0013656:                                                                        BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(stack_save_operands)))
0013657:                             {
0013658:                                 result.error = buffer.error;
0013659:                                 return result;
0013660:                             }

0013663:                                 codegen_canonical_x64_metadata_gpr(X64_REGISTER_RSP, 64),

0013665:                             };

0013668:                                                                        BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(stack_align_operands)))
0013669:                             {
0013670:                                 result.error = buffer.error;
0013671:                                 return result;
0013672:                             }
0013673:                             for (u32 argument_index = 0; argument_index < argument_count; argument_index += 1)
0013674:                             {
0013675:                                 CodegenCanonicalCallArgument* call_argument = arguments + argument_index;
0013676:                                 if (!call_argument->on_stack)
0013677:                                 {
0013678:                                     continue;
0013679:                                 }
0013680:                                 u32 argument_offset = value_offsets[instruction->operands[argument_index + 1].value];

0013682:                                 // is already at an offset respecting its own

0013684:                                 // the widest of them, so the slot address is
0013685:                                 // whatever the stack pointer already is.
0013686:                                 if (!codegen_canonical_x64_copy_frame_to_rsp(&buffer, argument_offset, canonical_x64_frame_base_offset,
0013687:                                                                              call_argument->stack_offset, call_argument->stack_part_count * 8,
0013688:                                                                              CODEGEN_X64_STACK_ALIGNMENT))
0013689:                                 {
0013690:                                     result.error = buffer.error != CODEGEN_ERROR_NONE ? buffer.error : CODEGEN_ERROR_CAPACITY;
0013691:                                     return result;
0013692:                                 }
0013693:                             }
0013694:                         }
0013695:                         bool windows_dynamic_call = windows_dynamic_stack && result.abi == CODEGEN_ABI_X86_64_WINDOWS;
0013696:                         if (windows_dynamic_call)
0013697:                         {
0013698:                             codegen_canonical_x64_adjust_stack(&buffer, call_layout.windows_stack_size, true);
0013699:                             if (buffer.error != CODEGEN_ERROR_NONE)

0013701:                                 result.error = buffer.error;
0013702:                                 return result;
0013703:                             }
0013704:                         }

0013714:                                                                                call_argument->copy_size, call_argument->copy_alignment)))

0013717:                                     return result;

0013734:                                  padding += 8)

0013739:                                 {

0013741:                                     return result;
0013742:                                 }
0013743:                             }

0013750:                                 {
0013751:                                     result.error = buffer.error;
0013752:                                     return result;
0013753:                                 }
0013754:                             }

0013756:                         }

0013758:                         {

0013816:                                         return result;
0013817:                                     }

0013822:                                 }

0013835:                         }
0013836:                         if (call_x64_indirect_return)
0013837:                         {

0013839:                             if (call_layout.windows_result_copy_size)

0013844:                                 // the sixteen-aligned frame slot cannot take.

0013866:                                     result.error = buffer.error;
0013867:                                     return result;
0013868:                                 }

0013871:                         IrType* call_callee_type = ir_type_from_id(&program->types, function->values[instruction->operands[0].value].canonical_type);

0013900:                                 return result;
0013901:                             }
